title: Same-spin correlation screens the exchange peak of the electron gas near 2kF
abstract: Exchange alone gives the electron gas a local field factor with a sharp peak just below 2kF. Quantum Monte Carlo finds none. Both spin channels are computed here from their lowest diagrams with a dynamically screened interaction and no fitting. Parallel spin correlation is the negative image of exchange and removes about half the peak; the calculated spin-resolved factors account for the QMC data at rs = 1 and 2, and at q = 0 for the compressibility and spin susceptibility obtained from the ground-state energy. The two classes of diagrams are the two terms of the kernel of Hedin's vertex equation, of which the second is routinely dropped.
summary:
1. 针对电子气交换近似在略低于2kF处预言尖峰而量子蒙特卡洛未见此峰的矛盾，作者以动态屏蔽相互作用的最低阶图无拟合计算两自旋通道的局域场因子。
2. 同自旋关联呈交换贡献的负像，削去约半数峰高，所得结果符合rs=1、2的蒙特卡洛数据及零动量热力学约束，并揭示Hedin顶角核中常被舍弃项的作用。
3. 结果支持在顶角近似中保留两类核图，但其在更强关联密度区间的适用性仍待检验。

title: An exactly solvable obstructed seam on a lattice Klein bottle: bulk-locked Majorana rings and register-dependent toric codes
abstract: We study a frustrated seam produced by literal reflection gluing of Wen's plaquette model on a closed lattice Klein bottle. The seam operators anticommute along two cycles for even circumference and one cycle of twice the length for odd circumference. Their algebra reduces to free Majorana rings, while the commuting bulk stabilizers constrain the allowed ring sectors. This bulk locking yields exact ground energies, excitation gaps and degeneracies, checked by phase-aware Pauli traces and finite-size diagonalization, including two 24-qubit energy predictions. The seam degeneracy is not topological: the single-site seam fields tested split it at second order. We contrast this obstructed gluing with consistent toric-code realizations. An edge register preserves the anyon labels; a Hadamard-dressed site register has colour-dependent seam transport, with ground-state degeneracy 2 or 4 for even circumference and a sign-frustrated exception at odd circumference. For the enumerated lattice isometries and sizes, we compute logical gates and distances, distinguishing abstract qubit relabelling from local hardware depth. Finally, on three 16- and 24-qubit lattices, chiral matter selects a holonomy doublet whose electric-field splitting follows two competing tunnelling routes. These matter results remain finite-size statements. The main result is the exact obstructed-seam solution with bulk sector locking; the register, gate and matter calculations delimit its relation to topological codes.
summary:
1. 针对克莱因瓶上反射粘合引发的受挫接缝，作者将文氏方格模型的接缝代数化为自由马约拉纳环，并用体稳定子约束允许扇区。
2. 该解给出精确基态能、能隙与简并度，并经泡利迹和有限尺寸对角化核验；所测单点接缝场在二阶劈裂简并，表明其不受拓扑保护。
3. 与一致环面码实现的比较表明，寄存器选择影响接缝输运和基态简并；逻辑门结论限于枚举的晶格，而物质诱导的双重态及隧穿劈裂仍是有限尺寸结果。

title: Planckian dissipation per unit critical entropy as a coupling-free probe of the strange-metal bath
abstract: Strange metals pair a resistivity linear in temperature with a specific heat $C/T$ rising logarithmically on cooling. We find that, if electrons scatter off a local critical bath, the coupling cancels in the ratio $Q$ of their coefficients, leaving two measurable numbers: how slowly the bath relaxes, seen in photoemission or optics, and the share of critical entropy that relaxes current. Baths form classes: $Q\le4.91$ for a conformal bath, as SYK models confirm; 9--15 for the Yukawa--SYK field; and far less for Kondo lattices. LSCO, at $Q\approx9$, exceeds the conformal bound, pointing to the Yukawa--SYK field.
summary:
1. 针对奇异金属线性电阻与对数增长比热的关联，作者在电子受局域临界浴散射的框架下构造两者系数比Q，消去耦合强度并关联浴弛豫及参与电流弛豫的临界熵份额。
2. 共形浴满足Q≤4.91并获SYK模型验证，Yukawa–SYK场给出9—15，而LSCO的Q≈9超出共形上界，使该比值成为区分临界浴的定量判据。
3. LSCO结果在局域临界浴假设下支持Yukawa–SYK场，但尚不足以唯一确定其微观机制，可结合光电子能谱或光学测量进一步检验。

title: Machine learning enabled design of sustainable alloys considering real world constraints
abstract: Designing sustainable alloys must reconcile high performance with real-world constraints, including feedstock scarcity and variability, processing and energy requirements, regulatory thresholds, and economic limitations. Addressing these constraints reaches far beyond today's conventional performance-focused frameworks. It needs to consider not only complex property-processing-performance trade-offs but also sustainable production pathways. Here, we propose a physics-informed ensemble (PIE) learning framework that integrates fundamental structure-property relationships with processing routes and sustainability criteria for mechanism-based alloy design. It predicts properties from composition-microstructure relationships and infers processing routes under sustainability constraints, establishing an interdisciplinary approach to identifying sustainable alloy solutions. We validate the approach for Mg alloys, a lightweight yet energy-intensive metallic material class, considering performance, cost, and carbon emissions. Trained on a benchmark dataset, the PIE model systematically explores plausible alloy compositions and microstructures to construct a digital library of millions of candidate alloys. From this space, we identify two sustainable Mg alloy solutions that overcome the conventional performance-cost-emission trade-off: a rare-earth-containing alloy increases yield and tensile strength by 72.8 percent and 61.1 percent, respectively, over alloys from the same family at comparable cost and emissions; and a rare-earth-free alloy reduces cost and carbon emissions by 40.4 percent and 88.9 percent, respectively, relative to its primary-feedstock counterpart, without compromising mechanical performance. This work introduces a general, physics-informed, and quantifiable framework for designing sustainable alloys under real-world constraints.
summary:
1. 针对合金性能与成本、排放等约束的冲突，作者构建融合组织—性能关系及加工路径的物理信息集成学习框架，以镁合金验证并筛选数百万候选方案。
2. 筛得的含稀土方案在成本和排放相当时使屈服及抗拉强度分别提高72.8%和61.1%，无稀土方案较原生原料方案降低成本40.4%、碳排放88.9%，且不牺牲力学性能。
3. 该框架为多约束合金设计提供可量化路径，但摘要未说明候选方案是否经实物验证，其可制造性及跨体系适用性仍待检验。

title: Bayesian Inference in Partially Observed Critical Systems
abstract: We ask how much of a large random system must be observed before a global average can be inferred with controlled uncertainty. For the random transposition shuffle, a conjugate Bayesian estimator of the average displacement, computed from $m$ uniformly sampled cards, has relative uncertainty $1/\sqrt{2m}$, independent of the deck size $n$. The law of total variance exposes a second error, the floor $R_n$, which arises because the observed configuration is a single draw from equilibrium: no relative tolerance below $\kappa\sqrt{R_n}$ can be certified, even by a census. For the shuffle we derive $R_n=(2n^2+7)/\bigl(5(n-1)^2(n+1)\bigr)$ and show that the posterior remains calibrated. At the critical point of the two-dimensional Ising model the floor of the energy vanishes, whereas that of the magnetisation stays near $0.072$; its mean-field limit is $\sqrt{2}-1$. For correlated fields read by sensor networks, the usual 95\% interval covers the ensemble mean in 7\% of cases. Bounding the floor from one realisation, as in single-chain Monte Carlo diagnostics, requires an assumption on the decay of correlations.
summary:
1. 针对局部观测能否以可控不确定度推断随机系统的全局平均，作者以随机换位洗牌和临界二维伊辛模型为平台，结合共轭贝叶斯估计与全方差分解分析抽样误差和单次平衡构型的涨落。
2. 洗牌中抽取m张牌的平均位移估计相对不确定度为1/√(2m)，与总牌数无关且后验保持校准，但即使全量观测仍有认证精度下限，临界伊辛模型的能量误差底消失而磁化误差底约为0.072。
3. 结果提示增加观测量不能普遍消除单次实现对系综均值推断的限制，而从单次实现约束误差底仍需假设关联的衰减规律。

title: Cutting, Shuffling and Diffusion as a Coarsening Process
abstract: Cutting and shuffling (CS) rearranges fluid without stretching, but homogenisation requires diffusion (D); this interaction is not well understood. We show that CSD is a coarsening process, with scale $\bar\ell=L(n_c\mathrm{Pe}/2)^{-1/3}$ rather than the Batchelor scale, and that cutting acts as a fractional Laplacian in wavenumber, giving the exact mixing rate $\gamma=2^{1/3}|a_1'|n_c^{2/3}\lambda\mathrm{Pe}^{-1/3}$ for $n_c$ cuts per event at rate $\lambda$, with $a_1'=-1.0188\dots$ the first zero of $\mathrm{Ai}'$. This holds in any dimension for random and deterministic protocols, extends to finite-time mixing, and places CSD in a known non-equilibrium universality class.
summary:
1. 针对无拉伸的切割重排如何与扩散协同实现流体均匀化，作者通过波数空间分析，将该过程刻画为粗化，并揭示切割对应于波数空间中的分数阶拉普拉斯算符。
2. 其特征尺度为L(n_cPe/2)^{-1/3}而非巴彻勒尺度，精确混合率为2^{1/3}|a₁′|n_c^{2/3}λPe^{-1/3}，其中n_c为每次切割数、λ为事件频率，a₁′为艾里函数导数首零点。
3. 该理论适用于任意维度的随机及确定性方案，并延伸至有限时间混合，将此类过程归入已知非平衡普适类，为比较不同切割混合策略提供尺度依据。

title: AlgebrasTQD: Computing Algebras and Interfaces in Twisted Quantum Doubles
abstract: We present AlgebrasTQD, an open-source code written in GAP (Groups, Algorithms, and Programming), for computing condensable algebras and the corresponding topological boundaries and interfaces of twisted quantum doubles $D^\omega(G)$. These algebras can be used to classify 1+1d gapped and gapless phases whose symmetry is related by gauging to a finite group $G$ with anomaly $\omega\in H^3(G,U(1))$, to study 2+1d anyon proliferation and to construct logical gates in non-Abelian topological quantum codes. The functions in AlgebrasTQD compute all condensable algebras $A(H,F,\gamma,\epsilon)$ with their algebra structure and anyons, sort them into isomorphism classes and identify the twin algebras that are inequivalent but share the same anyon decomposition. AlgebrasTQD also determines all the subalgebra relations, the corresponding Hasse diagram and the types of 1+1d phases for any chosen, possibly non-invertible, group-theoretical symmetry. For non-maximal algebras, the code computes the reduced topological order with its $3$-cocycle and the map of anyons across the topological interface. Finally, AlgebrasTQD includes functions that construct certain non-Clifford logical gates via non-Abelian surface codes. We summarize the formulas that are implemented in the AlgebrasTQD code, and we illustrate its use with Abelian and non-Abelian groups including $\mathbb{Z}_2^3$ with $\omega_\text{III}$, $D_8$, $A_4$ with and without anomaly, twin algebras and twin phases, and the Clifford-hierarchy gates in quantum doubles of dihedral groups. All arithmetic is exact and AlgebrasTQD can be used with any finite group $G$ and 3-cocycle $\omega$, limited only by the time and size of the calculation. The code is available at this https URL
summary:
1. 为刻画扭曲量子双的凝聚、边界与界面，作者开发GAP开源程序AlgebrasTQD，以精确算术计算有限群及其三上闭链对应的可凝聚代数。
2. 程序枚举代数及同构类，区分任意子分解相同但不等价的孪生代数，并计算子代数关系、凝聚后的拓扑序及跨界面任意子映射。
3. 该工具可支持含反常及非可逆对称性的相分类，并已实现部分非Clifford逻辑门构造，但任意有限群上的实际计算规模仍受时间与资源限制。

title: Typicality of entanglement growth and transport fluctuations in quantum symmetric exclusion processes
abstract: We use macroscopic fluctuation theory (MFT) to establish the typicality of charge-transfer statistics and entanglement dynamics in the quantum symmetric exclusion process, a model of stochastically hopping free fermions with diffusive transport and long-range quantum coherence. We show that the leading long-time charge-transfer full counting statistics of individual noise realizations coincide almost surely with those of the classical symmetric exclusion process (SSEP), in equilibrium and following quenches from arbitrary occupation-diagonal product states. Our results apply to transient fluctuations in the thermodynamic limit, extending previous work that has primarily focused on stationary regimes. Our approach compares the noise averages of the charge-transfer generating function and its inverse. The former reduces to SSEP, while the latter maps to an auxiliary Brownian energy process whose MFT saddle-point problem is related to that of SSEP, yielding matching large-deviation exponents. Through free-fermion identities relating entanglement to subsystem-number fluctuations, this establishes the self-averaging of the covariance-matrix eigenvalue distribution and of Rényi and von Neumann entropies. We obtain asymptotically exact predictions for entanglement growth from domain-wall and Néel initial states, in excellent agreement with numerical simulations.
summary:
1. 作者用宏观涨落理论研究随机跃迁自由费米子的量子对称排斥过程，通过比较电荷转移生成函数及其逆的噪声平均，检验输运涨落与纠缠动力学的典型性。
2. 热力学极限下，单次噪声实现的长时主导电荷转移统计几乎必然等同于经典模型，并由此确立纠缠熵自平均，给出畴壁与奈尔初态纠缠增长的渐近精确预测。
3. 结果将典型性分析从稳态推进至瞬态涨落，但结论限于该扩散自由费米子模型及所述极限，能否推广至相互作用体系仍待研究。

title: Mesons, Confinement, and Complexity: A Krylov Space Perspective on the Long-Range Ising Chain
abstract: We investigate the interplay between confinement and Krylov complexity in the long-range transverse-field Ising chain, where power-law interactions $\sim 1/r^{\alpha}$ generate an effective confining potential between domain walls without an explicit symmetry-breaking field. Using the time-averaged Krylov state complexity after a quench as a diagnostic, we find that the complexity is strongly suppressed and only weakly system size-dependent at small $\alpha$ and small transverse field $h_x$, where confinement is strongest, and crosses over to rapid growth at larger $\alpha$, where it increases with system size. Within the confined regime, the oscillation frequencies of the complexity agree with the meson masses of an effective two-kink model, with the dominant frequency growing linearly with the lightest meson mass and the time-averaged complexity decreasing approximately as its inverse square. We further study operator Krylov complexity at finite temperature using the Wightman inner product. At low temperature, it exhibits bounded oscillations that directly encode the meson spectrum, whereas this structure is progressively washed out as the temperature increases. These results identify Krylov complexity as a spectroscopic probe of interaction-induced confinement and reproduce, in a microscopic lattice model, the hallmarks of Krylov complexity identified in confining field theories.
summary:
1. 作者研究长程横场伊辛链中幂律相互作用诱导的畴壁禁闭，以淬火后态复杂度及有限温算符复杂度探查其克雷洛夫空间特征。
2. 强禁闭下复杂度受抑且尺寸依赖弱，振荡频率吻合双扭结模型的介子质量，主频随最轻介子质量线性增长，时间平均复杂度近似按其平方反比下降。
3. 结果支持以克雷洛夫复杂度探测无显式对称破缺场的相互作用诱导禁闭，但低温算符振荡中的介子谱结构随升温逐渐消退。

title: Universal Scaling of Conditional Mutual Information in Classical Stochastic Dynamics
abstract: Conditional mutual information (CMI) characterizes dependence between two regions conditioned on an intervening buffer. Its characteristic decay length, the Markov length, has recently been identified as a diverging length scale at mixed-state phase transitions. Here, we investigate CMI dynamics in one-dimensional classical stochastic models and propose a universal scaling form for systems whose Markov length diverges with time. We derive this form in the inactive phase of parity-conserving directed percolation, where domain-wall coarsening generates a growing length scale and a self-similar probability distribution. We introduce a Hankel-based truncation scheme that enables matrix-product-state simulations at long times and over large spatial regions. Using this method, we verify the proposed scaling both in the inactive phase and at the nonequilibrium critical point, where the dynamical critical exponent governs Markov-length growth. More broadly, the same scaling form captures cases in which collective inference sets the diverging Markov length. Despite these distinct mechanisms, the CMI between fixed microscopic regions exhibits a common scaling dimension of two. Finally, we extend this framework to temporal CMI, establishing an analogous relation between the strength of conditional dependence in time domain and its characteristic memory time.
summary:
1. 针对马尔可夫长度随时间发散的一维经典随机动力学，作者在宇称守恒定向渗流中推导条件互信息标度形式，并以基于汉克尔截断的矩阵乘积态模拟检验。
2. 模拟在非活跃相及非平衡临界点验证该标度，临界点的长度增长受动力学临界指数控制，而畴壁粗化与集体推断机制下固定微观区域间的条件互信息均呈标度维数二。
3. 推广至时间条件互信息后，该框架建立了条件依赖强度与记忆时间的类似关系，为比较不同机制提供统一描述，但其普适性仍需在更广泛模型中检验。

title: The Glass Transition: From Competing Theories to Discriminating Tests
abstract: The dramatic slowing down of liquids approaching the glass transition remains unresolved, partly because competing theoretical explanations are difficult to discriminate. Indeed, several mature, contrasting frameworks account for the main features of glassy phenomenology, making agreement with familiar observations a weak basis for identifying the microscopic mechanism responsible for the slowdown. Recent numerical advances are changing this situation in two complementary ways. Deep equilibration extends controlled equilibrium studies into regimes previously accessible only by extrapolation, allowing established predictions to be stress-tested over a broader dynamical range. At the same time, new numerical methods increasingly provide direct access to theory-specific quantities such as configurational entropy, static lengths, elastic properties, and local activation barriers. I discuss how these developments constrain thermodynamic, facilitation-based, elastic, and excitation-based descriptions. The emerging picture is not yet a unique theory, but a set of increasingly discriminating tests that can reveal where apparently successful laws cease to be universal and identify the microscopic ingredients that causally control the activation barrier.
summary:
1. 针对玻璃化前液体急剧慢化的机制之争，作者评述深度平衡与新数值方法如何检验热力学、动力学促进、弹性及激发图景。
2. 深度平衡拓展受控检验的动力学范围，构型熵、静态长度、弹性性质及局域激活势垒的直接计算则为区分理论提供更具针对性的判据。
3. 这些进展尚未确立唯一理论，但有望揭示既有规律的适用边界，并辨识因果上控制激活势垒的微观要素。

title: A 3D-$Δ$PDF-like measure for hidden anisotropy in disordered materials
abstract: We introduce a simple correlation function for quantifying hidden local anisotropy in disordered materials. Developed in analogy with the three-dimensional difference pair distribution function (3D-$\Delta$PDF), our approach identifies structural correlations that are lost through averaging over bulk symmetry. The same approach might be applied to models of disordered crystals, amorphous materials, and liquids alike.
summary:
1. 针对无序材料中被体相对称性平均掩盖的局域各向异性，作者借鉴三维差分对分布函数构建了用于量化该特征的简单关联函数。
2. 该方法可识别常规对称性平均所丢失的结构关联，为表征隐藏的局域各向异性提供直接度量，但摘要未给出定量性能或具体体系验证。
3. 这一关联分析有望推广至无序晶体、非晶材料和液体模型，但其跨体系适用性目前仅为提出的可能方向。

title: Coulomb- and exchange-driven redistribution of spectral correlations
abstract: Electronic correlations reorganize not only the energies of individual electronic states but also the collective structure of the spectrum. Here, first-principles density functional theory calculations combined with random-matrix spectral statistics are used to examine this reorganization in gamma-Ce within a static spin-polarized DFT+U+SOC description. We distinguish the effects of the Coulomb interaction U from those of the exchange interaction J by analyzing nearest-neighbor spacings, reduced spacing ratios, band velocities, and band curvatures across the Ce-4f manifold. Increasing U does not produce a monotonic transition between Poisson- and Wigner-Dyson-like statistics; instead, the region of strongest level repulsion migrates across the 4f manifold as the interaction increases. Exchange produces a qualitatively different response. At fixed U, strongly repulsive and strongly clustered spectral regions coexist within the same 4f manifold even while the total spin moment and 4f occupation remain nearly unchanged. The clustering persists after resolving the spectrum into its dominant j = 5/2 and j = 7/2 components and differs strongly between calculations having the same numerical value of U-J. Within the present DFT+U+SOC description, the spectral response therefore depends on the separate Coulomb and exchange interactions and cannot be represented completely by a single effective U-J parameter. These results show that energy- and character-resolved spectral statistics expose correlation-driven electronic reorganization that is hidden by conventional integrated observables.
summary:
1. 作者以静态自旋极化DFT+U+SOC结合随机矩阵谱统计，研究γ-Ce中库仑作用U与交换作用J如何分别重组4f谱关联。
2. 增大U使最强能级排斥区迁移而非单调改变统计类型，J则使排斥与聚集区共存，揭示有效U−J参数无法完整描述的谱重组。
3. 能量与轨道特征分辨的谱统计可揭示自旋矩和占据数近乎不变时的电子重组，但结论限于该静态描述，尚待动力学与实验检验。

title: Ensemble-dependent condensate statistics and correlations in an ideal Bose gas
abstract: The choice of statistical ensemble has a measurable impact on the statistical description of Bose-Einstein condensates beyond the well-known grand canonical anomaly. We develop a segmented-contour approach for the ideal Bose gas, which refines the saddle-point approximation by including non-Gaussian corrections in the canonical and microcanonical ensembles. The method applies to a broad class of noninteracting spectra, and provides efficient access to condensate fluctuations, higher moments, and correlation functions. For a three-dimensional harmonic trap with fixed anisotropy, we find that the ratio of the maxima of the microcanonical and canonical condensate-number variances approaches the theoretically predicted asymptotic value $1-3\zeta(3)^2/[4\zeta(2)\zeta(4)]\approx 0.391$ only extremely slowly with increasing particle number. We also show that ensemble effects are visible in the second-order correlation function $g^{(2)}(x)$ near the condensation crossover. After ballistic release from a three-dimensional harmonic trap, the time evolution of $g^{(2)}(x)$ preserves the differences between statistical ensembles.
summary:
1. 针对理想玻色气体凝聚统计的系综依赖性，作者发展分段围道方法，在正则与微正则系综的鞍点近似中纳入非高斯修正，计算涨落、高阶矩与关联。
2. 固定各向异性的三维谐阱中，两系综凝聚粒子数方差峰值之比随粒子数极缓慢趋近0.391，凝聚交叉区的二阶关联也呈现系综差异。
3. 弹道释放后的二阶关联演化保留系综差异，提示其可用于辨识系综效应，但结论限于所研究的理想气体，尚不涉及相互作用。

title: Physical structure as an organizing principle for universal Hamiltonian learning
abstract: Density functional theory (DFT) gives the electronic structure of materials, but its cost limits large-supercell calculations and materials screening. Machine-learned Hamiltonians bypass the self-consistent cycle but are usually system-specific; universal ones could cover new compositions and disordered solids. Such models must generalize across chemistry and keep downstream properties physical, while staying inexpensive for large cells. Here we introduce UniTB, a universal E(3) equivariant Hamiltonian representation framework that integrates physical priors rooted in density-functional tight-binding theory with deep learning. UniTB's network, which corrects a prior Hamiltonian, generalizes across chemistry through a mixture of experts routed by that prior and a charge-equilibration head as in self-consistent-charge tight binding. A projection bounds band shifts from the prior, suppressing spurious states and keeping downstream properties physical. We provide the fastest SO(2) tensor-product GPU kernels for the network. The variant UniTB-Flash assembles its prior from two-center tables at $O(N)$ cost for $N$ atoms, against $O(N\log N)$ on a grid. Trained on 29,242 crystals, UniTB reaches a 0.48 meV matrix-element error on nonmagnetic test crystals spanning 68 elements. Without amorphous training data, both models agree with DFT optics and conductivity of amorphous Ge-Sb-Te. UniTB-Flash ranks candidates with no significant difference from UniTB, whose property values are more accurate; together they screen 16,195 crystals for five application domains of industrial relevance.
summary:
1. 针对通用哈密顿量学习的跨化学泛化与物理可靠性，作者提出融合紧束缚先验、电荷平衡及能带偏移约束的等变框架UniTB。
2. 经29242种晶体训练，模型在涵盖68种元素的非磁性测试晶体上达0.48毫电子伏矩阵元误差，且无需非晶训练数据即可复现非晶Ge-Sb-Te的DFT光学与电导结果。
3. 已完成16195种晶体筛选，先验构建成本线性的Flash变体支持高效候选排序，但其物性数值精度低于UniTB。

title: Three-dimensional quantum Hall insulators in magnetic pyrochlore systems
abstract: We show that a class of pyrochlore materials provides a route to realize 3D Quantum Hall insulators, based on magnetic texture and flat band interference. We study itinerant electrons on a pyrochlore lattice Kondo-coupled to localized moments living on another interpenetrating pyrochlore lattice, with the moments forming a field-selected three-in/one-out texture. The noncoplanar texture generates complex spin-dependent hopping amplitudes and unequal local exchange energies, reconstructing the compact-localized parent flat bands into narrow bands separated by a global three-dimensional gap. The low-energy states are concentrated predominantly on kagome planes within the three-dimensional lattice, reflecting the combined effects of quantum interference and the texture-induced sublattice potential. When the lowest band is fully occupied, the response is characterized by a Chern triplet $\mathbf{C}=(1,1,1)$ and reciprocal Hall vector $\mathbf{G}_{\mathrm{H}}=(2\pi/a)(1,1,1)$, giving $\sigma_{yz}=\sigma_{zx}=\sigma_{xy}=e^2/(ha)$. The quantized bulk Hall response enforces chiral surface spectral flow, visible as noncontractible Fermi loops at the surface. Our work opens a new direction in the search for three-dimensional quantum Hall physics in magnetic pyrochlore systems, and suggests a broad design principle based on the interplay of magnetic texture and flat-band interference.
summary:
1. 作者研究磁性烧绿石中三维量子霍尔绝缘态的形成，在巡游电子与局域磁矩近藤耦合模型中考察外场选定的三入一出磁结构。
2. 磁结构与平带干涉共同产生全局三维能隙，最低带满占时陈数三元组为(1,1,1)，三个霍尔电导分量均为e²/(ha)，并伴随手性表面谱流。
3. 结果提出利用磁结构与平带干涉设计三维量子霍尔态的理论路线，但具体材料中的实现仍待验证。

title: A cascade of orbital-field-driven phases with a Lifshitz-type transition to unidirectional spiral order
abstract: Frustration in magnetic systems gives rise to unconventional orders and exotic spin liquids. Here, we explore a new type of frustration arising from an intrinsic bond-dependent orbital-field that couples orbital degrees of freedom to spin correlations. Introducing this orbital-field interaction into the antiferromagnetic Heisenberg model on the honeycomb lattice, we show that local spin-orbital constraints generate a subextensive degeneracy, lifted by order-by-disorder to select distinct collinear magnets in a cascade of phases as the orbital field increases from a para-orbital liquid. At larger fields, the selected phase gives way to an incommensurate unidirectional spiral that spontaneously breaks chiral symmetry. This transition is driven by the coupling of a Goldstone mode to gapped dynamical spin-orbital fluctuations. The spin stiffness becomes negative along a particular direction, while the spiral wavevector grows as the square root of the distance from the transition, signaling a Lifshitz-type transition. We present a microscopic route to realizing this orbital field and discuss candidate materials.
summary:
1. 作者在蜂窝晶格反铁磁海森堡模型中引入键依赖轨道场，研究轨道自由度与自旋关联耦合如何产生受挫及场驱动磁序。
2. 局域约束产生的次广延简并经无序致序选出一系列共线磁相，更强场下单向自旋刚度变负，形成破缺手性对称性的螺旋序，其波矢按距转变点的平方根增长，表征利夫希茨型转变。
3. 所提出的轨道场微观实现路径和候选材料为检验该相变机制提供方向，但摘要未报告材料中的实验实现。

title: Ratchet Effects for Swarmalators on Asymmetric Substrates
abstract: Swarmalators are particles which have internal degrees of freedom in the form of phase oscillators that can synchronize and change the dynamics of the particles. We explore the active matter disk swarmalator model proposed by Adorjáni [Phys. Rev. E 109, 024607 (2024)] where there is an additional attraction or repulsion determined by whether the phases of particles within a certain radius synchronize or anti-synchronize. This model in the absence of swarmalator rules forms a motility-induced phase-separated (MIPS) state at high activity, but when the swarmalator rules are present, a number of additional states appear including an active gel, labyrinth state, frustrated MIPS, and frustrated fluid states. Here we examine ratchet effects for the Adorjáni model coupled to asymmetric substrates. We find that swarmalator interactions can strongly enhance or suppress active matter ratcheting depending on the structural state of the system, and show that the ratchet efficiency depends on the substrate strength, substrate lattice spacing, and the motor force on the particles. The gel state exhibits the weakest ratcheting for small substrate spacing and can even produce a reversed ratchet motion, but shows the strongest ratcheting for large motor forces. The labyrinth state exhibits the strongest ratcheting over a wide range of parameters since the quasi-one-dimensional labyrinth morphology can match the substrate geometry well.
summary:
1. 作者研究相位同步如何调控活性粒子的棘轮输运，采用相位相关吸引或排斥的圆盘群振子模型，考察非对称基底上的结构与定向运动。
2. 群振子相互作用可增强或抑制输运：凝胶态在小基底间距下最弱且可反向，在大驱动力下最强；迷宫态因形貌匹配，在广泛参数范围内表现最强。
3. 结果提示可借助集体结构与基底几何匹配调控活性输运，但结论限于所考察模型，尚需检验其对其他相位耦合与基底形式的适用性。

title: Large superconducting diode effect indicates nonuniform triplet pairing in UTe2
abstract: The superconducting diode effect (SDE) is characterized by unequal critical current magnitudes for opposite-polarity current flow, owing to broken spatial-inversion and time-reversal symmetries. For a superconducting pair wavefunction to spontaneously break inversion symmetry implies the formation of Cooper pairs with nonzero momentum, yielding a nonuniform superconducting state. For singlet superconductors, the formation of such a (FFLO) state has long been understood to provide an escape from high field Pauli pair-breaking -- how and why such an effect might occur for equal spin pairing is an open question. Here we report the observation of a large SDE in bulk specimens of the three-dimensional heavy-fermion triplet superconductor UTe$_2$, with a peak diode efficiency of 33% at the high magnetic field strength of 33.6 T, representing the highest-field observation of the SDE to date. Crucially, this nonreciprocal transport is strictly confined to a narrow field regime where superconductivity coexists with a field-induced spin-polarized state near a first-order metamagnetic phase boundary. The absence of the SDE away from this slender phase-intersection argues strongly against purely extrinsic vortex pinning asymmetries. Instead, our findings indicate spontaneous inversion symmetry breaking accompanied by finite-momentum Cooper pairing. We model this behavior using a phenomenological Ginzburg-Landau theory, demonstrating that the intertwining of magnetic and triplet superconducting orders can stabilize an odd-parity FFLO state.
summary:
1. 针对等自旋三重态配对为何形成非均匀态的问题，作者测量块体重费米子超导体UTe₂的高场非互易输运，并以金兹堡—朗道理论建模。
2. 二极管效率在33.6 T达33%，且效应仅见于一级变磁边界附近超导与自旋极化态的狭窄共存区，支持有限动量配对而非纯外禀涡旋钉扎解释。
3. 模型表明磁序与三重态超导序交织可稳定奇宇称FFLO态，但输运证据尚非配对空间调制的直接观测，仍需进一步验证。

title: p-Adic statistical field theory of fluctuation effects in hierarchical neural networks
abstract: The Buice-Cowan field theory [PRE 75, 051919 (2007)] describes fluctuations and correlations of neural activity through a path integral whose mean-field limit is the Wilson-Cowan equation and whose critical behavior belongs to the directed percolation class. In its continuum limit the neurons are the points of a Euclidean space and activity spreads by ordinary diffusion, which encodes neither the hierarchical organization of cortical networks nor their small-world property. We formulate a version of the theory in which the neurons are organized in an infinite, self-similar, tree-like structure, described by the p-adic numbers. The path integral carries over unchanged, and finite networks are exact restrictions of the continuum theory. The main change is in the linear response: in the Euclidean theory every short-range kernel reduces to the Laplacian, while in the p-adic theory each connectivity kernel gives its own nonlocal p-adic diffusion operator. For couplings that decay by a fixed factor per level of the hierarchy this is the Taibleson-Vladimirov operator, and the critical theory is an ultrametric Reggeon field theory whose upper critical dimension is twice the decay exponent of the coupling. Hence the decay of the coupling up the hierarchy, and not the dimension of space, decides whether mean-field exponents apply. We obtain a Ginzburg-type criterion, loop-corrected hierarchical Wilson-Cowan equations, log-periodic corrections to scaling and power-law correlations. Exact simulations on a tree support the predictions: the avalanche-size exponent takes the mean-field value 3/2 when the coupling decays slowly and decreases toward the directed-percolation value when it decays fast. The hierarchical network is also small-world when the decay exponent is smaller than the dimension, a property that the Euclidean theory obtains only by assuming long-range coupling.
summary:
1. 为研究层级神经网络中的涨落与临界行为，作者以p进数描述自相似树结构，构建统计场论并用树上精确模拟检验。
2. 连接核决定非局域扩散，耦合衰减指数控制平均场适用性；模拟显示慢衰减时雪崩大小指数为3/2，快衰减时向有向渗流值降低。
3. 该框架为统一描述层级连接、涨落与特定衰减条件下的小世界性质提供理论路径，但其对真实皮层网络的适用性尚待验证。

title: Hierarchical connectivity sets the upper critical dimension of neural avalanches
abstract: Neural avalanches with size exponent $3/2$ are usually explained by mean-field critical branching, which for short-range coupling requires dimension $N\ge4$. We show that hierarchical connectivity removes this constraint. In a $p$-adic version of the Buice--Cowan field theory, a coupling that decays by $p^{-(N+\sigma)}$ per hierarchical level selects the Taibleson--Vladimirov operator, and the critical theory is ultrametric directed percolation with upper critical dimension $N_c=2\sigma$. Exact simulations on a tree give $\tau_S=3/2$ for $\sigma\le N/2$, decreasing continuously for $\sigma>N/2$.
summary:
1. 作者以p进Buice–Cowan场论和树上精确模拟，研究层级连接如何改变神经雪崩的临界维数及尺寸分布。
2. 逐层衰减的耦合导出超度量有向渗流，上临界维数为2σ；σ≤N/2时尺寸指数为3/2，超过该阈值后连续减小。
3. 结果表明层级连接可绕过短程模型对四维及以上的要求，但其对真实神经网络的适用性仍待检验。

title: Rotational Perturbation Theory for Magnetic Interactions
abstract: We develop rotational perturbation theory for magnetic interactions in collinear and noncollinear systems, distinguishing prescribed rotations of exchange fields from constrained rotations of magnetic moments. At the full exchange splitting, we derive Green-function expressions for prescribedfield energy curvatures directly from perturbation theory, without invoking the local force theorem; constrained-moment curvatures additionally require the stationary magnetic response and are related to the inverse static susceptibility. We examine noncollinear pair interactions and planar and conical spin spirals, and derive the long-wavelength ferromagnetic spin-wave stiffness and, assuming adiabatic sublattice precession, the antiferromagnetic spin-wave velocity. Orbital-nonlocal magnetic potentials and correlated electronic response reveal further requirements for connecting rotational curvatures to collective magnetic behavior. As a practical extension, we project the complete transverse pair Hessian onto an effective scalar Heisenberg exchange and quantify the unreconstructed curvature. Biquadratic and three-spin examples illustrate why locally extracted exchange coefficients need not represent transferable bilinear interactions.
summary:
1. 针对共线与非共线磁体系的旋转能量曲率，作者建立旋转微扰理论，以格林函数区分指定交换场旋转与受约束磁矩旋转。
2. 理论在完整交换劈裂下无需局域力定理即可推导场旋转曲率，将磁矩曲率联系于逆静态磁化率，并以完整横向成对海森矩阵的投影量化标量海森堡模型遗漏的曲率。
3. 该框架可用于检验有效交换模型的适用性，但局域交换参数未必可迁移，集体磁行为还需考虑非局域势与关联响应，反铁磁波速推导则依赖绝热子晶格进动假设。

title: Beyond Geometry: Hole-Edge Atomic Configuration as a Design Variable in Graphyne Kirigami
abstract: Kirigami-inspired cuts are an established route to stretchability in two-dimensional materials. At the nanoscale, however, cut edges are not purely geometric: they comprise discrete atomic configurations that can alter the mechanical response. In graphene, a given cut geometry fixes the edge structure; graphyne, a porous carbon allotrope with an intrinsic band gap, lifts this constraint, as identical cut geometries can yield distinct hole-edge configurations. Using molecular dynamics simulations, we report the first atomistic study of $\gamma$-graphyne kirigami (GYK), and compared with graphene kirigami. GYK reaches yield strains up to 9.6 times that of pristine $\gamma$-graphyne, with a response governed by both cut geometry and local hole-edge structure. Removing just two carbon atoms at selected edge sites further raises the yield strain by up to 35%, with little loss of yield stress. These findings identify hole-edge atomic configuration as an additional design parameter, expanding the design space for nanoscale kirigami engineering.
summary:
1. 针对纳米剪纸结构的力学响应是否取决于孔边原子排布，作者用分子动力学研究γ石墨炔剪纸并与石墨烯剪纸比较。
2. 模拟中屈服应变最高达原始γ石墨炔的9.6倍，选择性移除孔边两个碳原子可再提高至多35%，且屈服应力损失很小，显示几何之外的原子级调控作用。
3. 孔边原子构型可成为纳米剪纸力学设计的独立变量，但其增益目前仅由模拟支持，实验制备与验证仍待开展。

title: Constructive Cavity Method for Ising Restricted and Deep Boltzmann Machines with Gaussian Couplings
abstract: We apply the Constructive Cavity Method (CCM) to the dense, Ising type, restricted and deep Boltzmann machine with Gaussian couplings between adjacent layers. After identifying the core and interface contributions, CCM identifies the blanket decomposition of the cavity variables with the Aizenman--Sims--Starr random overlap structure. We apply the Random Energy Model (REM) universality ansatz to represent the cavity free energies by those of a generalized random energy model (GREM) and evaluate them recursively through Poisson point processes (PPPs). In the layer-wise gauge each layer is cut with its own cumulative fraction $|U_\ell\cap L_p|=\lambda_p q_\ell^{(p)}N+o(N)$, with $\mathbf 0=\mathbf q_0\le\mathbf q_1\le\cdots\le\mathbf q_r=\mathbf 1$, where $\mathbf q_\ell=(q_\ell^{(1)},\ldots,q_\ell^{(K)})$. Here $U_\ell$ is the cumulative blanket union up to blanket $\ell$. The index $p$ labels architectural layers, whereas $\ell$ labels the blankets. The dependence on the multilayer geometry is carried by the two matrices $M=2M_0\Lambda$ and $M_1=\Lambda M_0\Lambda$. The constructive cavity field in layer $p$ has blanket variances $Q_\ell^{(p)}-Q_{\ell-1}^{(p)}=(M(\mathbf q_\ell-\mathbf q_{\ell-1}))_p$, while the correction field has blanket variances $Q_\ell-Q_{\ell-1}=\mathbf q_\ell^\top M_1\mathbf q_\ell-\mathbf q_{\ell-1}^\top M_1\mathbf q_{\ell-1}$. The nested REM--PPP average gives the finite-level constructive cavity functional $\mathcal{P}_{\mathrm{RBM/DBM}}^{\mathrm{CCM}}(\zeta,\mathbf q)=\log2+\sum_{p=1}^K\lambda_pX_0^{(p)}-\frac12\sum_{\ell=0}^{r-1}\zeta_\ell(\mathbf q_{\ell+1}^\top M_1\mathbf q_{\ell+1}-\mathbf q_\ell^\top M_1\mathbf q_\ell)$. The balanced scalar gauge is recovered by imposing $\mathbf q_\ell=q_\ell\mathbf 1$. Selecting the physical value in the non-convex multilayer regime is a separate problem.
summary:
1. 针对高斯层间耦合的稠密伊辛型受限与深层玻尔兹曼机，作者用构造性空腔法研究自由能，并基于随机能量模型普适性假设进行泊松点过程递归。
2. 所得有限层级空腔泛函以两个矩阵编码多层几何，明确各层空腔场与修正场的方差，并在各层重叠同步时还原标量规范。
3. 该框架为分析多层自旋玻璃自由能提供候选泛函，但依赖普适性假设，非凸多层情形中如何选取物理值仍待解决。

title: First-principles-based search for emergent topological spin textures in transition-metal dichalcogenide monolayers
abstract: Topological spin textures such as skyrmions and bimerons offer rich physical functionalities and strong potential for future spin-based technologies. Identifying materials that host such emergent magnetic states, however, remains challenging due to the complex interplay between microscopic magnetic interactions and large-scale spin textures. Here, using a multiscale first-principles discovery framework, we identify a broad class of two-dimensional materials that stabilize nontrivial spin textures. The framework integrates relativistic density functional theory, magnetic force theory, and atomistic spin-dynamics simulations, enabling a direct connection between electronic interactions and emergent magnetic textures and allowing efficient screening of systems with large magnetic unit cells and competing exchange interactions. Applying this approach, we systematically screen 312 monolayer transition-metal dichalcogenides across 1T and 2H phases of 3d, 4d, and 5d transition metals. We uncover a diverse set of emergent spin textures, including skyrmions, bimerons, and complex domain states, and clarify their distinct stabilization mechanisms driven by exchange interactions, Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interactions, and magnetic frustration. These results identify promising candidate materials for topological spin textures and establish a transferable computational framework for accelerating materials discovery of complex magnetic states in two dimensions.
summary:
1. 针对微观磁相互作用如何稳定拓扑自旋织构，作者结合相对论密度泛函、磁力理论与原子自旋动力学，筛选了312种1T和2H相单层过渡金属硫族化合物。
2. 计算发现斯格明子、双半子及复杂磁畴态，厘清交换作用、Dzyaloshinskii–Moriya相互作用与磁阻挫的稳定机制，连接电子结构与大磁性单胞织构。
3. 该框架可用于筛选二维复杂磁态候选材料，但预测织构的实验实现及器件适用性仍待验证。

title: Continuum neural wavefunctions for anyons on a torus
abstract: Mobile anyons in topologically ordered phases provide a setting to investigate how fractional exchange statistics shapes collective behavior at finite density. We introduce AnyFormer: a neural variational framework for continuum anyons on a torus that explicitly incorporates statistical interactions and global winding constraints. We construct a smooth orbital frame that enforces the matrix-valued torus boundary conditions, and supplement it with an analytic pair factor that supplies the regular collision behavior. The orbital geometry and many-body amplitudes are optimized in parallel by variational Monte Carlo. We apply AnyFormer to semions without an external field or interaction potential, isolating unique correlations generated solely by statistics. Our framework closely matches exact two-semion energies and yields lower variational energies than finite-cutoff exact diagonalization for $N = 4$ and $6$ semions. Scaling up to $N = 16$ semions, well beyond the limits of continuum diagonalization, our calculations reveal states with pronounced correlation holes, suppressed long-wavelength density fluctuations, and a reversal of pair circulation at a distance set by the mean particle spacing. For $N = 12$ and $16$ semions, the circulation develops damped spatial oscillations. AnyFormer thus provides a scalable variational neural-net framework for microscopic studies of correlations, chiral motion, and collective phases of bulk anyonic matter.
summary:
1. 为研究分数统计如何塑造有限密度关联，作者构建环面连续任意子的神经变分框架，以轨道标架和解析对因子满足边界及碰撞约束，并用变分蒙特卡洛优化。
2. 无外场和相互作用势的半子计算吻合双粒子精确能量，四、六粒子能量低于有限截断对角化结果，并扩展至十六粒子，揭示纯统计驱动的关联穴、长波密度涨落抑制及对环流反转。
3. 该框架可用于探索任意子物质的手性运动与集体相，但现有变分结果尚不足以确立热力学极限下的相结构。

title: Comprehensive QM/ML Study of Dislocation Loop Line Segments in α-Zr Part I: <a> Loop Core Geometries, Solute Binding, and Transition Barriers
abstract: Zr cladding alloys in nuclear reactors are exposed to high neutron fluxes, making irradiation-induced defects and solute segregation central to understanding their in-service behaviour. Dislocation cores involve short-range chemistry and long-range elastic fields, which are difficult to describe simultaneously using conventional atomistic methods. Using a hybrid quantum mechanics/machine learning (QM/ML) framework, this part of work examines prismatic <a> loops in hcp {\alpha}-Zr. All three loop variants are considered, including faulted and perfect, interstitial- and vacancy-type, and first- and second-order prismatic configurations. Nine possible dislocation line segments are characterised in terms of core geometry, solute binding, glide barriers and faulted-to-perfect transition pathways using QM/ML and newly implemented QM/ML-NEB calculations. Shockley and half-Shockley partials, together with basal and prismatic fault ribbons, are found to govern core stabilisation. Fe and H preferentially bind to faulted segments, whereas Sn and Nb favour perfect segments. Solutes can also drive partial motion, recombination and local unfaulting. These results establish a comprehensive picture of <a> loop microstructure, solute trapping and transition mechanisms in {\alpha}-Zr.
summary:
1. 针对α锆中棱柱面〈a〉位错环的芯结构与溶质耦合，作者结合量子力学／机器学习框架及NEB计算，研究三类环的九种线段、滑移势垒与去层错路径。
2. 结果显示部分位错与层错带主导芯稳定化，Fe、H偏聚于层错线段，Sn、Nb偏好完整线段，且溶质可驱动部分位错运动、复合及局部去层错。
3. 这些原子尺度结果为理解锆包壳中的溶质俘获与位错环演化提供依据，但其对辐照服役行为的影响仍需进一步验证。

title: Designing Geared Molecular Rotors in Flexible Metal-Organic Frameworks
abstract: Translating macroscopic mechanical concepts such as gears to the molecular scale offers a route to precise control over nanoscale motion, inspired by the efficiency of biological machines. In this work, we explore two-dimensional interlocked linker rotations in the flexible metal-organic framework NU-2002. The volume-dependent free energy landscape is mapped using bias-deletion metadynamics to identify six characteristic phases, ranging from very closed to very open pore. We then perform unbiased molecular dynamics simulations at each phase to track rotation events and evaluate co-rotation statistics, calculate free energy barriers, and measure pairwise radial force transfer between neighbouring linkers. We show that the free energy barrier acts as a rotational-speed filter, where rare rotational transitions lead to higher speeds on average. Across the volume profile, we classify four distinct geared regimes: sterically restricted rotations at small volumes (Jammed Gear), rotational coupling extending to third neighbour linkers (First Gear), in-plane partnered linker coupling (Second Gear), and uncoupled, independent rotation at large volumes (Neutral Gear). Together, these results establish framework breathing as a molecular gearbox that switches both the speed and collective coupling of linker rotation. Framework flexibility therefore offers a handle for programming collective motion in solid-state molecular machines.
summary:
1. 为探究框架呼吸如何调控分子齿轮，作者以偏置删除元动力学和无偏分子动力学研究柔性金属有机框架NU-2002，解析六个特征相中的连接体转动与力传递。
2. 模拟揭示四种随体积切换的转动状态，从位阻锁定、耦合延至第三近邻到平面内配对及独立转动，并发现稀有跃迁对应更高平均转速的势垒筛选效应。
3. 结果支持以框架呼吸调节转速和集体耦合的分子变速箱图景，为可编程固态分子机器提供设计线索，但尚需实验验证。

title: Where Does the Anion-Redox Hole Go? Reliability of Open-Shell Projection-Based Embedding for Li-Rich Cathodes, from DFT Environments to Quantum Solvers
abstract: Anion redox in Li-rich layered oxides places holes on oxygen next to an antiferromagnetic Mn(IV) d3 lattice, a strongly correlated open-shell problem for which projection-based wavefunction-in-DFT embedding offers a route to correlated and quantum solvers, but whose errors are known mainly for closed-shell molecules. We develop a spin-unrestricted projection-based embedding, exact at the DFT-in-DFT level to the microhartree scale for closed-shell, broken-symmetry and high-spin references with point charges, and apply DMRG-in-DFT to point-charge clusters of delithiated Li(2-x)MnO3, varying the environment functional (0-100% exact exchange), geometry, active region, active-space spin, virtual space, cluster size and magnetic reference. In every setting the lowest SCF state places the hole on an oxygen pair, with no O-O bond. How the hole is shared depends on the functional together with the geometry: hybrids give a full, uncoupled hole at the DFT+U geometry but a partial, weakly covalent hole at their own geometry, a change of up to 0.5 e on one oxygen. Where spin spreads across the active/environment boundary, the integer spin projection of the active space becomes a choice worth up to 0.26 e, and at most 0.09 e once the two Mn neighbors are included. An extended state search found missed lower states for two functionals, changing a pair-oxygen spin by up to 0.45 e. Across all 82 runs the embedded mean field gives the same hole (median DMRG change 0.02-0.04 e); correlation mainly adds O-O covalency. State control and geometry consistency, not the solver, dominate the uncertainty, and total energies are not converged at 30-40 orbitals. For quantum solvers, the embedded Hamiltonian must be spin-unrestricted: a shared-orbital form reverses the hole, while sample-based quantum diagonalization reproduces exact diagonalization, as accurately as, but not better than, classical selected CI.
summary:
1. 针对富锂正极氧空穴的归属与嵌入可靠性，作者建立自旋非限制投影嵌入，在脱锂锰酸锂点电荷团簇上用DMRG检验环境、几何与自旋选择。
2. 82次计算均显示嵌入平均场已确定主要空穴分布，DMRG改变量中位数仅为0.02—0.04电子，关联主要增强氧氧共价性，而几何变化可使单氧空穴改变达0.5电子。
3. 可靠预测应优先控制电子态与几何一致性，量子求解需保留自旋非限制形式，但总能量尚未收敛，已测量子方法也未优于经典选组态相互作用。

title: Atom as an Agent: Emergent Order by Collective Predictive Coding
abstract: What is the intrinsic reason of emergence of macroscopic order parameter out of microscopic systems? In this article, we apply to physics the collective predictive coding (CPC), the theory of language/symbol emergence. As our language emerges out of our human communications, physical macroscopic order parameter emerges out of communications among atoms --- each atom is regarded as an agent who predicts each other's behavior through inference. We present three examples of classical spin systems: two-dimensional ferromagnetic and antiferromagnetic Ising models, a two-dimensional spin model with competing stripe orders, and the fully connected Sherrington--Kirkpatrick spin-glass model. In all of these examples, proper macroscopic order parameters including the replica overlap emerge automatically through communication informatics of CPC, only from observed spin configurations. We call the learned macroscopic coordinate the collective predictive order. Furthermore, for the ferromagnetic and antiferromagnetic Ising models, the equilibrium distribution of the collective predictive order yields an emergent potential with the symmetry and thermal evolution characteristic of a Landau potential. Notably, the emergence of the collective predictive order does not refer to any structure of microscopic Hamiltonians/Lagrangians. Thus our ``Atom-as-an-Agent" (AaaA) principle offers a completely data-driven method for the emergence of macroscopic order, that is, machine learning physics.
summary:
1. 为探究微观系统如何涌现宏观序，作者将自旋视为相互推断的智能体，以集体预测编码分析伊辛、竞争条纹及全连接自旋玻璃模型。
2. 仅凭自旋构型、无需微观哈密顿量结构，该方法自动提取包括副本重叠在内的序参量，并在铁磁与反铁磁伊辛模型中得到具有朗道势对称性和热演化特征的涌现势。
3. 结果支持从观测数据识别宏观序的路径，但尚不能据此确立普适涌现机制，其对更广泛物理系统的适用性仍待检验。

title: Ground-State Properties of a Lattice-Coupled Strongly Correlated Model for Solid Oxygen under Pressure
abstract: Solid oxygen is an $S=1$ molecular magnet with strong coupling between spin and lattice degrees of freedom. Recent studies suggest that magnetic moments coexist with tetramer distortions under pressure. We derive an effective spin Hamiltonian from a two-orbital Peierls--Hubbard model with spin-orbit coupling. The resulting model contains competing easy-plane single-ion and easy-axis exchange anisotropies. We analyze this model on a square lattice using quantum Monte Carlo simulations and evaluate the magnetic contribution to the lattice stiffness for several lattice distortion patterns including the tetramer pattern. We find that the tetramer pattern is the most favorable among the considered distortion patterns throughout the parameter range studied. Moreover, competition between the two anisotropies enhances the tendency toward lattice distortion and strengthens the preference for tetramerization over the other patterns.
summary:
1. 针对受压固态氧中磁矩与四聚畸变的共存，作者从含自旋轨道耦合的双轨道模型导出自旋哈密顿量，以方格子量子蒙特卡洛计算多种畸变的磁性刚度贡献。
2. 在所考察的全部参数范围内，四聚图样均最有利，且易面单离子与易轴交换各向异性的竞争增强畸变倾向及四聚化偏好。
3. 结果为磁性促进四聚化提供了模型依据，但结论限于所研究的参数及畸变图样，尚不足以确定真实固态氧的完整结构稳定性。

title: In-situ Control of the Photon-Magnon Synchronized Mode in a Miniaturized Magnetometer
abstract: Photon-magnon synchronized modes (PMSMs) provide a route for magnetic-field sensing by exploiting their enhanced field responsivity due to cusp points (CPs). However, the previous PMSM magnetometer relies on bulky discrete components and lacks in situ control of photon-magnon interactions, limiting its integration and adaptability. Here, we demonstrate a miniaturized PMSM magnetometer integrated on a printed circuit board. A variable resistor is used to tune the photon-magnon coupling strength in situ. By adjusting the variable resistor, the electromagnetic boundary condition of the magnetometer is altered; hence, the reservoir-mediated photon-magnon interaction is changed. The coupling strength shows a non-monotonic dependence on the reflection coefficient adjusted by the variable resistor and reaches its minimum at the impedance matching condition. Furthermore, we develop a non-Hermitian model with standing-wave interference to describe the PMSM dispersion and derive the critical condition for CP formation. This work realizes a compact and tunable PMSM magnetometer and provides a pathway for controlling photon-magnon interactions in integrated magnetic sensing systems.
summary:
1. 针对光子—磁振子同步模式磁力计体积大且相互作用难以原位调控的问题，作者在印刷电路板上集成微型器件，以可变电阻调节电磁边界及储库介导耦合。
2. 耦合强度随反射系数非单调变化，并在阻抗匹配时最小，含驻波干涉的非厄米模型描述了同步模式色散并给出尖点形成的临界条件。
3. 该结果为集成磁传感中的可调光子—磁振子相互作用提供了实现路径，但摘要未报告灵敏度或探测极限，尚不能据此判断测量性能的提升。

title: Intercomponent vortex interaction and dynamics in a uniform Bose quantum liquid
abstract: We investigate the interaction and dynamics of vortices belonging to different components of a binary uniform quantum liquid. Using the coupled extended Gross-Pitaevskii equations with logarithmic beyond-mean-field corrections, we derive the asymptotic interaction potential between well-separated vortices. The interaction potential retains the asymptotic form $s^{-2}$ as a function of the intervortex distance s, but its coefficient depends on the background density through the quantum fluctuation. As a result, the interaction between vortices changes from attractive to repulsive at a critical density. Real-time simulations demonstrate a corresponding reversal of orbital motion of a vortex pair from clockwise to counterclockwise, consistent with their Magnus response.
summary:
1. 针对双组分均匀玻色量子液体中的跨组分涡旋，作者用含对数型超平均场修正的耦合扩展Gross-Pitaevskii方程推导远距相互作用，并模拟实时动力学。
2. 涡旋间势保持距离负二次方标度，但量子涨落使其系数随背景密度变化，在临界密度处由吸引转为排斥，涡旋对轨道运动相应由顺时针反转为逆时针，符合马格努斯响应。
3. 结果揭示密度调控涡旋相互作用与轨道方向的机制，但证据限于渐近分析和数值模拟，实验验证仍待开展。

title: Algebraic flat bands and even central-band Chern numbers in a seven-orbital hopping model
abstract: Turning a flat-band parent into an isolated Chern band requires supervise of destructive interference, hopping phases, and the cell translations of the bonds. We study this connection in a seven-orbital 2 times 2 supercell honeycomb-vacancy lattice, combining analytic reductions with Bloch spectra, lattice Chern invariants, and quantum geometry. The parent lattice has three exact flat branches, a smooth periodic zero mode, and a compact localized state. A uniform gap bound shows that faint intracell-loop hopping preserves two topologically trivial insulating gaps. The intracell hopping graph also admits a staggered chiral coloring: reversing site amplitudes according to this coloring links opposite energies at momenta separated by half a reciprocal period. This constraint restricts the isolated central band to even Chern numbers and forbids a zero-energy insulating filling at every loop phase. Purely imaginary loop hopping admits a real gauge, whereas other phases allow paired band contacts connecting central bands with C3=2 and C3=4. On a specified strong-loop cut, third-order masses open the direct gaps; these gaps shrink faster than the bandwidth as the coupling grows. Changing the bond connectivity to an oriented honeycomb next-nearest-neighbor extension generates a narrower Chern band with nonuniform quantum geometry. These results distinguish individual-band topology from occupied-group topology and reveal how bond connectivity and cell translations determine which topological bands can emerge from an exactly flat parent.
summary:
1. 为厘清精确平带如何转化为孤立陈带，作者在七轨道蜂窝空位超胞模型中结合解析约化、布洛赫谱、陈数与量子几何计算，考察环跃迁及键连接的作用。
2. 交错手征约束使孤立中央带的陈数只能取偶数，并禁止零能绝缘填充；相位调节允许陈数为2与4的中央带经成对接触相连，而强环耦合下直接带隙比带宽衰减更快。
3. 定向次近邻连接已产生更窄的陈带，但量子几何仍不均匀，表明键连接与晶胞平移是设计旋钮，而带宽压缩并不保证隔离度改善。

title: Spatial localization of magnetic-branch force contrasts in substitutional Mn-doped Ge: A first-principles study
abstract: Magnetic energy gaps do not reveal the spatial distribution of magnetic-state-dependent atomic forces. We compare ferromagnetic and antiferromagnetic forces at identical nuclear positions in 64-site substitutional Mn-doped Ge using collinear PBE calculations. For nearest-neighbour Mn pairs, the radial force projection reverses sign between magnetic branches. In the second-neighbour geometry, the shared Ge neighbour has the largest force contrast, about 2.2 times that of equally near Ge sites coordinated to one Mn. Bridge-displacement gap slopes agree with direct force derivatives across four numerical settings. Tightening the electronic threshold by 100-fold preserves magnetic ordering and the leading site, while the force-contrast vector changes by 1.08% despite a nearly unchanged energy gap. The results identify coordination-associated localization of magnetic-branch force contrasts within the frozen model, without establishing relaxed distortions, full numerical convergence or a unique exchange mechanism.
summary:
1. 为揭示磁态相关原子力的空间分布，作者以共线PBE计算比较64位点替位Mn掺杂Ge在相同核坐标下的铁磁与反铁磁力。
2. 近邻Mn对的径向力投影随磁支反号，次近邻构型的共用Ge邻居力差约为单Mn配位等距Ge的2.2倍，且桥位移能隙斜率与直接力导数一致。
3. 结果在冻结结构模型内揭示了与配位相关的力差局域化，但尚未确立弛豫畸变、完全数值收敛或唯一交换机制。

title: Antisymmetric thermopower without magnetism in three-phase composites
abstract: A thermopower that turns a temperature gradient into a perpendicular electric field in every in-plane direction has relied on magnetism. Reciprocity permits it without magnetism, yet under a three-fold or higher axis it vanishes both in reciprocal elastic band transport and in composites of two isotropic phases with ideal interfaces. Here we show that composites of three isotropic phases carry it, and that under such an axis three is the minimum. A third, linearly independent transport matrix escapes the exact two-phase reduction; at weak contrast the first allowed axial term is cubic, proportional to a determinant of the three matrices times material-weighted, handed three-point correlations. Treating the phases as colours identifies the arrangements that allow the response, and crystal nets from reticular chemistry supply printable three-dimensional ones. Certified two-sided bounds give axial Seebeck coefficients of 49.5-50.2 $\mu$V K$^{-1}$ in a planar cell and 76-84 $\mu$V K$^{-1}$ in a printable woodpile; reflections in planes containing the axis reverse the response, and recolouring 24 nets to restore their parent symmetry switches it off. Around a line heat source the axial driving field has the $1/r$ azimuthal form of the magnetic field of a straight wire and drives circulating currents.
summary:
1. 作者以复合介质输运理论和可打印晶格研究无磁性横向热电响应，证明在三重及更高旋转轴下，三种各向同性组分是实现该响应的最少组分数。
2. 第三个线性独立输运矩阵突破两相约束，弱反差响应始于三阶手性关联，双侧界给出木堆结构轴向塞贝克系数为76—84微伏每开尔文。
3. 镜像反转响应、恢复母体对称性使其消失，表明几何手性可调控无磁热电环流，但可打印设计及数值界尚非实验验证。

title: Real-Space Selection Rule for Moiré Exciton-Phonon Coupling
abstract: Exciton-phonon coupling (ExPC) governs energy relaxation and exciton dynamics in photoexcited quantum materials. Recent advances have revealed rich and tunable excitonic phenomena in moiré superlattices, yet the microscopic mechanisms underlying the coupling between moiré excitons and moiré phonons remain elusive. Here, we develop a real-space representation for moiré ExPC based on a unified theoretical framework combining the many-body Bethe-Salpeter equation with phonon perturbation theory. Furthermore, we uncover a general real-space selection rule: the spatial matching of a moiré exciton's electron and hole densities with the moiré-phonon-induced potential perturbations determines their individual coupling contributions, while coherent interference between the electron and hole contributions controls the total ExPC. We demonstrate this rule in prototypical WSe2/WS2 moiré heterobilayers, revealing pronounced exciton- and phonon-mode-dependent coupling, including nearly complete suppression of ExPC through destructive electron-hole interference. These findings establish the internal electron-hole spatial configuration of moiré excitons as a key degree of freedom governing the strength and mode selectivity of their coupling to moiré phonons, opening opportunities to engineer ExPC through spatially tailored moiré potentials.
summary:
1. 针对莫尔激子与声子耦合的微观机制，作者结合多体贝特–萨尔皮特方程与声子微扰理论建立实空间表述，并在WSe₂/WS₂异质双层中验证。
2. 电子、空穴密度与声子扰动势的空间匹配决定各自贡献，其相干干涉控制总耦合，可通过相消干涉使特定激子与声子模的耦合近乎完全受抑。
3. 结果指出激子内部电子—空穴空间构型是调控耦合强度与模式选择性的自由度，空间设计莫尔势有望实现此类调控，但尚非实验演示。

title: Mixed symmetries in active non-reciprocal systems
abstract: Active materials are driven out of equilibrium at the microscopic scale and display diverse phenomenology; non-reciprocity is a subclass of activity in which action-reaction symmetry is also broken. These models are often grouped by the order of symmetry of their components, such as polar bird flocks or hexatic cellular tissues. However, many biological examples exist in which the components appear to have two or more symmetries simultaneously. To study this effect we introduce two independently controllable symmetries to the non-reciprocal XY model. This lattice model demonstrates wide ranging behavior dictated by the chosen symmetries. We derive a full hydrodynamic description of our lattice model that highlights the mechanisms driving its behavior. Each combination of symmetries can lead to a different hydrodynamic model with one or two simultaneous order parameters with different levels of orientational order that can appear active or not.
summary:
1. 针对活性非互易体系中多种取向对称性共存的问题，作者在非互易XY晶格模型中引入两种可独立调控的对称性，并推导完整的流体动力学描述。
2. 不同对称性组合产生不同的流体动力学模型，可包含一个或两个并存的序参量，呈现不同层级的取向有序及活性或非活性行为。
3. 该框架为研究生物材料中的混合对称性提供理论路径，但现有结果限于模型，尚需检验其与具体生物体系的对应关系。

title: Kinetic Sectors and Nonequilibrium Dynamics in the $δ$-Ising Model
abstract: We introduce and analyze the $\delta$-Ising model, a kinetic Ising ferromagnet in which single-spin flips are accepted when their energy change does not exceed a tunable threshold. Varying the field and threshold opens or closes local flip channels, dividing parameter space into kinetic sectors, each governed by a fixed Markov transition operator. We prove that the dynamics retains global spin-inversion symmetry exactly when up and down spins have equal numbers of open channels. In one such sector on a periodic chain of length $L$, unbiased random initial states therefore reach the field-aligned and antifield states with probability $1/2$ each. Closing a single channel leaves both states absorbing but makes the probability of ordering against the field decay as $(2/\pi)^L$. Parameter sweeps correspond to ordered products of sector operators, which separate reaching a state from holding it, so hysteresis appears when a state is reached and released at different sector boundaries. We also show how increasing the system size can induce a Mpemba-like reversal, allowing a state with more misaligned spins to reach the final ordered state sooner on average. On a periodic chain, this reversal arises because the mean absorption time grows logarithmically with system size for many short domains but linearly for a single macroscopic domain, and it disappears when the bulk flip channel is opened. These findings show how a simple, intuitive rule for Ising dynamics links local kinetic constraints to field response, memory, and relaxation within a unified framework.
summary:
1. 作者研究局域动力学约束如何控制非平衡磁响应，在单自旋翻转能变不超过可调阈值的伊辛铁磁模型中，以固定马尔可夫算符划分动力学扇区。
2. 证明全局自旋反演对称性等价于上下自旋开放通道数相等，且在周期链的特定扇区关闭一个通道后，逆场有序概率由二分之一降为随链长指数衰减。
3. 扇区边界区分状态的到达与保持并解释滞后，周期链中还发现随尺寸增大出现的姆潘巴式弛豫反转，但体内翻转通道开放后该反转消失。

title: HorizON: A Multi-Horizon Deep Operator Network for Property Prediction of Organic Battery Stacks
abstract: Transition-metal-based batteries rely on critical elements such as lithium, cobalt, and nickel. Their extraction creates environmental and supply-chain challenges. Organic electrode materials (OEMs) reduce this reliance and provide broad molecular tunability. However, OEM-based batteries still show limited long-term cycling stability. Their design also requires the joint optimization of coupled metrics such as voltage, specific capacity, capacity retention, and energy density. These metrics depend on the full battery stack and on the interactions among its components rather than on the active material alone. In our previous work, we developed a data-fusion multi-task framework for average discharge voltage and first-cycle specific capacity. Both targets are single-valued. Here, we extend that framework to multi-horizon prediction by predicting a property at every cycle of a discharge trajectory rather than at a single cycle. Our multi-fidelity and Multi-horizon Deep Operator Network learns DFT redox potentials and cycle-dependent specific-capacity trajectories within one model. We train it on complete battery-stack representations and usage conditions, so it learns battery-stack interactions rather than cathode-only effects. This framework supports long-term property prediction, inverse design, and process optimization for organic battery systems.
summary:
1. 针对有机电池性能受电池堆组分耦合与循环演化共同影响的问题，作者以完整电池堆及使用条件为输入，构建多保真、多时域深度算子网络。
2. 该模型联合学习密度泛函理论氧化还原电势与逐循环比容量轨迹，将单值预测拓展为循环依赖预测并纳入组分相互作用，但摘要未提供精度或预测跨度。
3. 该框架可为有机电池长期性能预测、逆向设计和工艺优化提供工具，但尚不能据此确认其外推可靠性或实际循环寿命改善。

title: Replica Analysis of Overfitting in Vector Generalized Linear Models
abstract: We show how the successful recent statistical physics based theory of overfitting in Generalized Linear Models (GLMs) can be generalized to a much larger family of regression models: the so-called Vector Generalized Linear Models (VGLMs), in which not a single linear combination of covariates drives the outcome, but where one has an arbitrary finite number of such linear combinations. The latter more general and complex models can describe more sophisticated statistical patterns in data, but are even more prone to overfitting than GLMs due to their significantly larger number of parameters; this often limits their use. We show that the generalization of the overfitting theory from GLMs to VGLMs causes many mathematical challenges that were absent from the earlier work, mostly related to the increased dimensional complexity of all order parameters in the theory, but that the new problem is once more solvable using the replica method. This opens up the field to many novel and welcome applications, especially in post-genome medical inference and data analysis, where overfitting is and remains a major barrier to progress. After developing the general VGLM overfitting theory, within the replica symmetric (RS) ansatz, we illustrate its merits and its correctness via application to several relevant VGLM regression models.
summary:
1. 针对由有限个协变量线性组合驱动的向量广义线性模型中过拟合问题，作者用复本方法在复本对称假设下推广统计物理理论。
2. 该框架处理了序参量维数增加带来的数学复杂性，并通过若干相关回归模型的应用检验，超越了单一线性组合的理论限制。
3. 这一理论为医学推断等高维数据分析提供了研究过拟合的新工具，但结论依赖复本对称假设，摘要未展示实际医学应用或过拟合消除效果。

title: Impurity-induced trimer formation across the BCS-BEC crossover
abstract: By means of diffusion Monte Carlo calculations, we study the behavior of a single impurity embedded in two balanced Fermi baths across the BCS-BEC crossover. The impurity interacts attractively with both baths through Pöschl-Teller potentials of different strengths. That interaction is such that does not support an impurity--bath two-body bound state. When that attraction is sufficiently strong, we observe the formation of trimers composed of the impurity and one atom from each bath. These clusters are Borromean on the BCS side, where no two-body subsystem is bound, and evolve continuously into tango-like trimers on the BEC side. Subtracting from the total energy the binding energy of one trimer and that of the remaining bath-bath dimers restores the equation of state of the impurity-free system, supporting a dilute-cluster interpretation. The analysis of interparticle distances shows that the embedded trimer is not simply a dimer dressed by the impurity, but a genuine three-body cluster formed inside the two Fermi baths.
summary:
1. 作者用扩散蒙特卡洛研究BCS—BEC跨越中双平衡费米浴内的单杂质，以不支持杂质—浴原子二体束缚态的吸引势探究三聚体形成。
2. 强吸引下形成真实三体团簇，由BCS侧无二体束缚子系统的博罗米恩态连续演化至BEC侧探戈型态，扣除团簇束缚能后恢复无杂质状态方程。
3. 能量与粒间距证据支持稀薄团簇图像而非杂质修饰二聚体，但结论限于所研究的单杂质模型，实验实现仍待检验。

title: The constrained molecular dynamics (CMD) to obtain spatio-temporal memory functions of viscoelastic liquids: stability analysis of equations of motion
abstract: Mechanical stress is one of the main characteristics of viscoelastic molecular systems, including vitrifying liquids and amorphous solids which are known to show long-range dynamical heterogeneities. It is therefore important to deal with time- and space-resolved local stress whose correlations can be used to obtain viscoelastic memory functions of such systems, in particular, their wave-vector dependent shear and compression relaxation moduli. However, such memory functions are not directly accessible within standard molecular dynamics (MD) simulations. Here we discuss a new method called the constrained molecular dynamics (CMD) which allows for a direct evaluation of the wave-vector and time dependent viscoelastic moduli. The study is focused, in particular, on the stability analysis of different variants of the CMD, revealing the most efficient stabilization algorithm. Our theoretical predictions for the time-dependence of the most important parameters (like the wave-vector resolved mass current) during the stabilization stage are compared with the simulation data using different CMD algorithms. An excellent agreement is observed, thus confirming the validity of our theoretical approach and its ability to accurately predict the most important initial part of CMD trajectories.
summary:
1. 针对标准分子动力学难以直接获取黏弹液体时空记忆函数的问题，作者研究约束分子动力学，分析不同运动方程方案的稳定性并与模拟比较。
2. 该方法可直接求取波矢和时间依赖的黏弹模量，并筛选出最高效的稳定化算法，理论对稳定阶段质量流等参数演化的预测与模拟高度一致。
3. 结果支持该理论预测约束轨迹关键初始阶段的能力，并为研究空间分辨的黏弹弛豫提供工具，但摘要未给出算法适用范围或长期稳定性的证据。

title: Residual dynamics determine dissipation in strongly coupled linear Langevin systems
abstract: Interactions shape the properties of many physical and biological nonequilibrium systems, but whether collective operation raises or lowers entropy production remains difficult to predict. Here, we show that strong coupling suppresses irreversible circulation associated with the directly coupled degrees of freedom. In identical two-dimensional systems, this suppression is monotonic for nonzero coupling modes and guarantees a monotonic decrease of the entropy production rate (EPR), with the corresponding probability currents vanishing in the strong-coupling limit. In higher dimensions, suppressing the circulation associated with the coupled degrees of freedom does not generally eliminate all irreversible circulation, since the remaining degrees of freedom can still sustain nonequilibrium currents. The EPR of these residual dynamics sets the strong-coupling limit, providing a criterion for whether a given choice of coupled variables leads to lower dissipation than the uncoupled system. The approach to this limit depends on how the finite-coupling current correction aligns with the residual current. Further, we show that convergence to residual dynamics in the strong-coupling limit also applies to coupled non-identical systems. Finally, we demonstrate the predicted EPR reduction in nonlinear models of vertebrate hair-cell bundles and bacterial chemotaxis.
summary:
1. 针对相互作用如何改变非平衡耗散，作者分析强耦合线性朗之万系统的概率流与熵产生率，并以毛细胞束和细菌趋化的非线性模型检验预测。
2. 相同二维系统的熵产生率随耦合单调降低，高维系统则可保留不可逆概率流，其残余动力学决定强耦合耗散极限，且该收敛结论适用于非相同系统。
3. 残余动力学为选择降耗的耦合变量提供判据，但强耦合不保证消除全部耗散，趋近极限的方式还取决于有限耦合电流修正与残余电流的相对方向。

title: Perimeter shell properties of branched polymer adsorbents in various conformational states
abstract: The structural accessibility and perimeter shell properties of branched macromolecules are studied using Monte Carlo simulations on a simple cubic lattice. Constituent polymer chains of these macromolecules are constructed in an algorithmic way as: a set of collinear monomers; a self-avoiding walk (SAW); tigthly packed monomers. These mimic the ground states for a rigid rod, flexible chain, and collapsed chain conformational states, respectively. We analyzed the set of observables that are related to adsorption, such as perimeter shell size (number of available sites for particle adsorption) per monomer $\langle \bar{n}_a \rangle$, mean coordination number of perimeter shell $\langle n_{\rm bond} \rangle$ (average number of contacts per adsorbed particle), and coordination accessibility per monomer $\langle \bar{n}_s \rangle$. Our results demonstrate that branching reduces the perimeter shell size while it increases mean coordination number of perimeter shell across all conformational states, due to higher local monomer density near branching cores and formation of shared adsorption sites or microcages. Stiff extended structures yield the highest values for $\langle \bar{n}_a \rangle$ (approaching $4$ in the limit of long chains), whereas the flexible ones provide the largest values for $\langle n_{\rm bond} \rangle$. We can note that the collinearity of monomers in constituent chains works in the same direction as reduction of branching ($\langle \bar{n}_a \rangle$ grows), whereas the { tight packing of them} -- in the same direction as the increase of branching ($\langle \bar{n}_a \rangle$ decreases)
summary:
1. 作者用简单立方晶格蒙特卡洛模拟，以共线、自回避和紧密堆积链模拟刚性、柔性及塌缩构象，考察支化对吸附位点可达性与接触数的影响。
2. 各构象中支化均减少外围吸附位点、增加位点平均接触数，源于局部致密化与共享位点形成；长刚性链每单体位点数趋近4，柔性结构平均接触数最高。
3. 结果提示可借支化与构象调节位点数量和多重接触的权衡，但晶格几何指标尚不能直接确证实际吸附容量或亲和力。

title: Transport statistics in asymmetric coupled chaotic dots in series: Brownian motion model
abstract: We study statistics of transport properties in a system of two quantum chaotic cavities coupled in series through a tunable junction and connected to reservoirs with asymmetric leads. Within the random matrix theory framework and in the absence of time-reversal symmetry, the scattering matrix S undergoes a crossover from two independent circular unitary ensembles to a single CUE as the inter-cavity coupling increases. Modeling this crossover using Dyson's Brownian motion approach, with the junction width acting as a time-like parameter, we derive closed-form expressions for the time-dependent averages and variances of conductance and shot noise power for arbitrary lead asymmetry. These analytical results reduce to known expressions in the symmetric and fully coupled limits. The mapping between the Brownian time parameter and the physical junction width is found to be observable-dependent, reflecting the different eigenfunction correlations probed by conductance and shot noise power, and this dependence is examined and separately calibrated for each observable. Validating against random-matrix simulations and tight-binding transport calculations using Kwant, we find quantitative agreement for ensemble-averaged observables throughout the crossover, while variances, being more sensitive to microscopic fluctuations, show deviations from the Brownian-motion predictions.
summary:
1. 作者针对非对称引线连接的串联混沌双腔，采用戴森布朗运动模拟无时间反演对称性下的耦合交叉，推导电导与散粒噪声均值及方差的闭式表达式。
2. 随机矩阵与紧束缚计算验证了全交叉区间内系综均值的定量一致性，并揭示布朗时间与结宽的映射依赖观测量，需分别标定。
3. 该方法可描述任意引线非对称下的平均输运，但方差仍偏离预测，提示进一步建模需考虑对微观涨落更敏感的相关性。

title: Langevin dynamics towards Generalized Gibbs Ensembles
abstract: In recent years, statistical physics tools have been used to study the dynamics of macroscopic quantum and classical integrable models. These studies have shown that, in the thermodynamic limit, long term time-averages of local observables equal statistical averages calculated with a Generalized Gibbs Ensemble (GGE). In the latter, the weight in phase space involves all constants of motion multiplied by Lagrange multipliers which are fixed by their initial values. We argue that the GGE can be interpreted as a proper Boltzmann measure of a different (non-standard) mechanical model. This measure can therefore be sampled with stochastic methods implemented, for example, as a Langevin process. We tailor the deterministic force in the Langevin equations so that at long times the stochastic trajectories sample the desired measure. We use the integrable Neumann Model -- the model of a classical particle constrained to move on a sphere under anisotropic harmonic potentials -- as a benchmark. We test the method in a setup where the Lagrange multipliers are fixed by the GGE governing the asymptotic dynamics of the isolated Neumann model following a quench. This problem has different phases depending on the initial conditions and quench protocol and, in all cases, with the stochastic evolution of an adequately tuned Langevin process we reproduce the asymptotic values of relevant observables.
summary:
1. 针对可积系统广义吉布斯系综的采样问题，作者将其重释为非标准力学模型的玻尔兹曼测度，并构造相应朗之万动力学，以球面约束下的经典诺伊曼模型检验。
2. 采用孤立模型淬火后系综所确定的拉格朗日乘子，调节后的随机演化在所测试各相中均复现了相关可观测量的渐近值。
3. 结果支持以随机采样研究可积系统的长期统计性质，但尚未验证对其他模型的适用性，亦不意味着朗之万过程复现原系统的真实动力学。

title: Phase Separation in a Mixture System of Active and Passive Particles
abstract: We carried out molecular dynamics simulations of a mixture of self-propelled particles (SPPs) and passive particles. When the self-propulsion speed was sufficiently high, the system separated into two phases. One phase consists of ordered passive particles, and the other is a disordered mixture of both particle types. The separation arises from the interplay between the self-propelled motion of SPPs and thermal motion of the passive particles, since phase separation does not appear with either particle type alone. As the self-propulsion speed increases, the SPPs push surrounding particles away, effectively increasing their excluded size. As a result, the increase in the effective excluded sizes promotes the accumulation of passive particles and the segregation of SPPs into the dilute phase through a mechanism analogous to the depletion interaction. This mechanism explains the phase separation observed in the present study. Our findings provide insights into the potential applications of SPPs and contribute to our understanding of natural systems composed of elements with different levels of motility.
summary:
1. 作者通过自推进粒子与被动粒子混合体系的分子动力学模拟，研究推进运动与热运动如何共同诱发相分离。
2. 足够高的推进速度使体系分为被动粒子有序相和两类粒子无序混合相，而单组分均不分相；其机制是推进增大有效排除尺寸，经类似耗尽作用促进被动粒子聚集。
3. 结果为理解不同运动能力组分的分凝提供了机制图像，并提示可用活性调控混合物结构，但其适用范围与实验实现仍待验证。

title: Magnetic crystal generation with site-resolved magnetic moments via Gaussian-mixture retargeting and finite-budget yield prediction
abstract: We introduce GMMag, a workflow for generating crystal structures together with their site-resolved magnetic moments, built on a conditional variational autoencoder with a graph neural network encoder and a transformer decoder. Gaussian-mixture sampling redirects generation towards selected chemical and magnetic targets without retraining. We systematically investigate how encoder and decoder design, the representation of magnetic-moment magnitudes and relative signs, and sampling choices affect reconstruction, generation quality and diversity. Because a higher screening pass rate does not necessarily yield more qualifying candidates with distinct chemical formulas absent from the reference dataset, we model how repeated generation of the same chemical formulas limits their accumulation and test the model in two separate ten-million-draw runs. As an application, the workflow identifies Nd-containing candidates with chemical formulas absent from the reference dataset, negative formation energies and high estimated saturation magnetization.
summary:
1. 为联合生成晶体结构与逐位点磁矩，作者构建条件变分自编码器，以图神经网络编码、变换器解码，并用高斯混合采样免重训地定向化学与磁性目标。
2. 该流程建模重复化学式对有限采样预算下独特候选积累的限制，并在两次各千万次抽样中检验，表明筛选通过率不等同于独特候选产率。
3. 筛得参考集中未见化学式、形成能为负且估算饱和磁化强度高的含钕候选，为磁性材料搜索提供方向，但其稳定性与磁性能仍待验证。

title: Magnetic structures in a model nickelate: Monte Carlo study
abstract: Within the framework of the classical Monte Carlo method with kinematic account of constant bosons concentration a model nickelate was studied, its magnetic structures for various values of exchange integrals considering up to third-nearest neighbours were determined.
summary:
1. 为考察交换作用如何影响模型镍酸盐的磁结构，作者采用在运动学上保持玻色子浓度恒定的经典蒙特卡罗方法，纳入直至第三近邻的交换作用。
2. 研究确定了不同交换积分取值下的磁结构，将较远邻交换纳入磁序分析，但摘要未给出具体磁序类型、参数范围或定量结果。
3. 这些结果可为分析交换作用与磁序的关系提供模型依据，但其对真实镍酸盐的适用性仍需结合具体材料参数及实验检验。

title: Hydrodynamic fluctuations in Luttinger liquids
abstract: We develop the theory of hydrodynamic fluctuations for one-dimensional quantum liquids. At low temperatures the relaxation of interacting electrons in a single-channel wire separates into two classes: equilibration, which changes the numbers of right and left movers through backscattering and is exponentially slow, and thermalization, which redistributes energy and momentum at a fixed number of movers at a power-law rate. This separation of time scales gives the electron liquid a two-fluid description analogous to superfluid $^4$He, with the zero mode of the Luttinger liquid as the superfluid component and the gas of thermal excitations as the normal component. Using Onsager reciprocity and the fluctuation-dissipation theorem, we add Langevin fluxes to the two-fluid hydrodynamic equations, including a mutual-friction noise generated by rare backscattering events that has no counterpart in helium.
