2. 该框架将希尔伯特空间、玻恩规则和经典概率结构导出为共同代数的极限投影，并声称以内禀有限性处理量子场论的紫外发散。
3. 这一构造为统一量子与引力描述提供候选路径，但摘要未给出可检验预言或具体模型验证，其引力解释仍需进一步论证。

title: Stability of attractive 3D Bose gases with repulsive three-body interactions
abstract: We consider three-dimensional Bose gases with attractive two-body interactions and repulsive three-body interactions. We prove the stability of the second kind of the system for a large class of interaction potentials and scaling regimes, which includes the Gross--Pitaevskii regime for the three-body potential. In addition, we even prove the classical stability of the system for a more restrictive class of interactions and scaling regimes. The main ingredient of the proof is a bound that was derived recently in a study by the authors on the dynamics of Bose gases with three-body interactions in the Gross--Pitaevskii regime (2026).
summary:
1. 针对二体吸引与三体排斥竞争下三维玻色气体能否稳定的问题，作者利用此前三体相互作用动力学研究中的界估计，严格分析多类势与标度。
2. 作者证明涵盖三体势Gross–Pitaevskii标度的第二类稳定性，即能量下界至多随粒子数线性降低，并在更严格条件下证明经典稳定性。
3. 结果为三体排斥抑制吸引气体能量失稳提供严格依据，但适用范围受势与标度条件限制，尚不能据此判定具体平衡态或动力学稳定性。

title: Symmetry-resolved fermionic correlations in iron-oxide ground spaces
abstract: Symmetries of quantum systems provide a natural way to organize the eigenspaces of many-body Hamiltonians. When degeneracies exist, however, they play a more subtle role as different sets of symmetry operators can resolve the same energy subspace into states with very different correlation properties. We study this interplay using a sequence of FeO and Fe$_2$O$_2$ models. For a Hubbard model of FeO, the ground space is 16-fold degenerate. Resolving it by local magnetizations gives a basis of Slater determinants, while total-spin quantum numbers select entangled and non-Gaussian states from the same ground manifold. Adding density-density Hund interactions breaks the independent spin rotations and reduces the ground space to a spin-reversal pair with maximal magnetization. These states are extremely close to Slater determinants in their natural occupations, yet have finite two-body cumulants and conserved-operator algebras whose orbit dimensions differ substantially from the Slater values. Fe$_2$O$_2$ provides a larger example in which spatial mode entanglement can be substantial while fermionic non-Gaussianity remains weak, with the conserved-operator structure again distinguishing the state from the corresponding Slater transformation class. Together, these examples show that symmetry resolution, mode entanglement, reduced-density-matrix correlations, and conserved-operator structure provide complementary information about interacting and degenerate electronic ground states.
summary:
1. 针对简并基态的关联如何依赖对称性分解，作者研究FeO与Fe₂O₂模型，结合纠缠、非高斯性、二体累积量及守恒算符代数进行分析。
2. FeO的16重简并基态按局域磁化分解得到斯莱特行列式，按总自旋分解则选出纠缠非高斯态；加入密度型洪德相互作用后，自然占据虽接近行列式，二体累积量仍有限。
3. Fe₂O₂中显著模式纠缠可与弱非高斯性并存，表明这些诊断互补，但结论目前限于所研究模型。

title: Diagonal, Switching, and Locally Optimal Unraveling for efficient quantum trajectories in metastable open quantum systems
abstract: Open quantum systems can display metastability, with multiple long-lived states coexisting. Examples include the bistability of bright and dim manifolds in nonlinear driven resonators, or the long-lived coherent states of opposite phases in parametrically-driven systems, the building block of cat-state-based quantum computers. Metastability often emerges at system sizes where density-matrix evolution is impractical. Quantum trajectories mitigate this issue by evolving wavefunctions rather than density matrices. Metastable states then emerge as attractors towards which the system rapidly relaxes until a rare switching event brings it to another attractor. Simulating them remains costly, as one must resolve fast intra-attractor dynamics over timescales long enough to gather switching statistics. To tackle this problem, we introduce the Diagonal, Switching, and Locally Optimal Unraveling (DiSLOU) method, which combines three optimization layers: (i) Switching among locally optimal unravelings that minimize the number of quantum jumps in each metastable region. (ii) Diagonal propagation: the no-jump evolution is accelerated by diagonalizing the non-Hermitian effective Hamiltonian once per attractor. (iii) Local reduced eigenspaces: the no-jump state can be faithfully propagated in a truncated subspace of only slowly decaying eigenmodes. We benchmark DiSLOU on the driven-dissipative Kerr resonator, finding no measurable loss of accuracy and the largest speedup in the bistable regime, where standard trajectories are most expensive. We then apply the method to the more challenging problem of accurately simulating rare bit-flip events in the cat manifold emerging in a two-mode dissipatively stabilized parametric oscillator, obtaining a performance improvement of over one order of magnitude. An implementation of DiSLOU in Julia is available as an open-source package.
summary:
1. 针对亚稳开放量子系统稀有跃迁采样昂贵的问题，作者提出DiSLOU量子轨迹法，结合局部最优解缠切换、无跳跃演化对角传播及慢衰减模截断。
2. 该法在驱动耗散Kerr谐振器中未见可测精度损失，双稳区加速最显著，并在双模耗散稳定参量振荡器的猫态比特翻转模拟中实现逾一个数量级的性能提升。
3. 结果支持更高效地估计猫态体系的稀有错误率，开源实现便于复用，但对其他亚稳体系的适用性仍待验证。

title: Equilibrium Learning of Quantum Circuits
abstract: Equilibrium learning trains a physical system using observables of its relaxed states. We extend this principle to gate-based quantum circuits by embedding a parametrized circuit in a Feynman-Kitaev (FK) Hamiltonian and imposing the compilation target either through an output clamping term or through a target-dependent cyclic condition on the clock register. The ground state energies and the overlaps of the corresponding ground states with the free history state define faithful cost functions for unitary and state compilation. We show that these costs are nonlinear functions of the compilation infidelity and therefore reshape the optimization landscape. We show that starting from the free history state, quantum phase estimation can prepare the relevant ground states and estimate the cost functions with polynomial resources. In two-qubit benchmarks, optimization with the equilibrium cost functions reaches a fixed fidelity threshold in fewer sweeps than standard compilation infidelity cost function for many instances. The results demonstrate the potential for encoding quantum learning problems as computation of equilibrium observables.
summary:
1. 作者将参数化量子线路嵌入费曼–基塔耶夫哈密顿量，通过输出钳制或目标依赖的时钟循环条件，为幺正与量子态编译构造平衡态代价函数。
2. 这些代价忠实反映编译误差并非线性重塑优化景观，可用量子相位估计以多项式资源求取，且双比特多实例测试中达到固定保真度阈值所需扫描轮数更少。
3. 结果支持将量子学习编码为平衡态可观测量计算的思路，但优化收益目前仅见于双比特基准，能否推广至更大线路仍待检验。

title: An algebraic characterisation of $n$-qubit pure-state invariants
abstract: We study the set of $n$-qubit pure quantum states. Specifically, we consider their incarnation as density matrices in Bloch representation. Building on prior work, we define a family of quadratic functions in Pauli expectation values, and fully characterise all instances that result in state-independent purity constraints. The resulting family of pure-state invariants is surprisingly rich in structure, with strong ties to the geometry of symplectic polar spaces. After charting the general landscape, we define a sub-family of pure-state invariants that satisfies the dynamical constraint of being stable under state update. We prove that it corresponds with (different embeddings of) symplectic Lie algebras $\mathfrak{sp}(2^{n-1})\subset\mathfrak{su}(2^n)$, which admit a generating set of Pauli operators. We carefully distinguish the symplectic case from its orthogonal counterpart, using the Arf invariant of quadratic refinements of the symplectic form on the projective Pauli group, which we further identify with quaternionic structures on $\mathbb{C}^{2^n}$ that are both generated by and restricted to Pauli operators. As a consequence of this analysis, we reveal previously largely overlooked structure in the $n$-qubit Pauli group. We highlight this in a number of examples. We characterise all state-independent uncertainty relations in variance for Pauli observables, as well as all Pauli channels for which the output fidelity and output purity are state-independent. We further show that the orbits of the projective stabiliser groups of pure-state invariants, which for $n\geq2$ are proper subgroups of the Clifford group, form complex projective state $2$-designs, while their unitary lifts form symplectic $2$-designs.
summary:
1. 作者在布洛赫表示下研究多量子比特纯态，完整刻画了由泡利期望值二次函数给出的、与具体态无关的纯度约束。
2. 研究证明态更新下稳定的不变量子族对应辛李代数的不同嵌入，并据此分类泡利可观测量的态无关方差不确定关系及输出保真度和纯度均态无关的泡利信道。
3. 相关稳定子群轨道构成复射影态二阶设计，为设计构造提供代数途径，但结论限于所述纯态与泡利框架，尚未展示实验实现。

title: Radial power-like potentials: from the Bohr-Sommerfeld $\ell \neq 0$ state energies to the exact ones
abstract: Two new Bohr-Sommerfeld (B-S) type quantization conditions for $d$-dimensional radial potentials are proposed for non-singular and singular potentials, respectively. The power-like potentials \hbox{$V=\operatorname{sign}(m)\,r^m$} for $m=-3/2,-1,-1/2, 1,3,4,6$ and $V=\log r$ (that corresponds to $m=0$) are studied in detail for radial quantum numbers $n_r \in [0,100]$ and for angular momenta $\ell=1,2,3,4,5$ in dimensions $d=2,3$. It is shown that for large $n_r$ the B-S energies $E_{BS}$ always tend to the exact ones. For $m=2$ (the radial harmonic oscillator) and $m=-1$ (the $d$-dimensional analogue of the $3D$ Coulomb potential) the B-S spectrum coincides with the exact one for the first and second quantization conditions, respectively. In general, up to a small parametric shift of the radial quantum number, the analytic formulas for the energy spectrum can be written for arbitrary power-like potential. A comparison of $E_{BS}$ with the energies $E^{(L)}_{BS}$, obtained for the radial potentials modified by the Langer correction for $d=3$, are in good agreement in general: in detail, it was checked for the quartic oscillator $V=r^4$. It is demonstrated that introducing a dimensionless {\it WKB correction} $\gamma$ into the r.h.s. of the proposed B-S type quantization condition allows us to reproduce the exact energies with $\gamma$ being very small for positive degrees $m \geq 0$ and sufficiently small for non-positive ones $m < 0$ for all $n_r, \ell$ studied.
summary:
1. 针对径向势非零角动量态的半经典能谱，作者为奇异与非奇异势分别提出玻尔—索末菲型量子化条件，考察二维、三维幂律及对数势。
2. 所考察能谱在大径向量子数下趋于精确值，谐振子与库仑势分别满足严格量子化；引入较小无量纲WKB修正可复现所测能级。
3. 结果提示可通过径向量子数的小幅参数平移构造一般幂律势的解析能谱，但修正量的普适性仍需超出已考察量子数与维度范围检验。

title: Dynamical behaviour of the mass tensor in the lattice
abstract: We study with the semiclassical model the dynamics of a particle moving in a orthorrombic lattice by the hopping mechanism in the presence of a static Coulomb field and a rapidly oscillating homogeneous field. Based on results for the anisotropic Kepler problem, where a chaotic trajectory arises due to different masses of the particle in the X and Y directions, and since this result is also obtained in the rectangular lattice at the continuum limit, the application of the oscillating field allows reparameterizing the effective masses so that they become equal in both directions. Thus, the result is an elliptic trajectory in the continuum limit of the lattice. This chaos-order transition is confirmed by the calculation of Lyapunov exponents for the different trajectories. It is also found that the application of an external magnetic field in the Z direction of the lattice yields chaos control which can be generalized beyond the simple case of the circular trajectory shown in this work. The previous scheme of chaos control was extended for trajectories in 3D in the continuum limit of the orthorrombic lattice which is also equivalent to the far region approximation where the particle moves with respect to the Coulomb field origin. In this case it found that the chaos control technique permits to observe two different dynamical regimes which, although consistent with Bohr-van Leeuwen theorem, suggests that an observable way to distinguish one from the other is to be sought.
summary:
1. 作者用半经典跳跃模型研究正交晶格中库仑场下的粒子动力学，考察快速均匀振荡场对有效质量各向异性及混沌的调控。
2. 振荡场可使两方向有效质量相等，在连续极限下将混沌轨道转为椭圆轨道，李雅普诺夫指数证实该转变，垂直磁场亦可控制混沌。
3. 该方案在三维连续极限、即远离库仑中心的近似下呈现两种动力学区制，均与玻尔—范勒文定理相容，但区分二者的可观测量仍待寻找。

title: Anomalous Structures of Fisher Zero Lines in Biorthogonal Dynamical Quantum Phase Transitions
abstract: Fisher zero lines of the Loschmidt amplitude in non-Hermitian quenches can exhibit anomalous structures in the complex time plane, such as divergence, separation, and the restriction of all branches or a specific branch to the real or imaginary axis. Here, we use the biorthogonal framework to reveal the origin of these structures and determine the corresponding critical momentum conditions by analyzing the values of $m_k=\hat{\mathbf{h}}_0\cdot\hat{\mathbf{h}}_1$, the dot product between the normalized prequench and postquench complex Bloch vectors. When Fisher zeros continuously cover the real-time axis, the density of Fisher zeros is further introduced to identify the critical times within these critical regions, at which the rate function becomes nonanalytic. We verify our results in a generalized non-Hermitian SSH model by quenching the Peierls phase and the non-Hermitian gain-loss strength, and also use the Jordan form to analyze the dynamics at postquench exceptional points, where the conventional Fisher zero formula is not applicable.
summary:
1. 作者在双正交框架下，通过分析淬火前后归一化复布洛赫矢量的点积，研究非厄米淬火中费舍零线异常结构的起源及临界动量条件。
2. 研究在广义非厄米SSH模型中验证相关判据，以零点密度识别实时间轴连续零点区域内的非解析时刻，并用约旦形式处理常规零点公式失效的淬火后例外点。
3. 这些结果为区分连续零点覆盖与真正的动力学临界时刻提供了判据，但其向所研究模型之外的适用性仍待检验。

title: Quantum State Preparation for Complex-Valued Amplitudes
abstract: We present a state preparation procedure that takes binary registers containing the real and imaginary parts of a complex number $z=x+iy$ and prepares an amplitude approximating $z/\alpha$, where $\alpha$ is a normalization constant. The magnitude and argument are computed using the Coordinate Rotation Digital Computer (CORDIC) algorithm. We then encode the magnitude into an amplitude, and apply phase gates to introduce the argument. A reversible in-place multiplier allows the coordinate updates to use fixed precision while clearing their temporary workspace. The procedure uses $O(n^2)$ $T$ gates and $O(n)$ additional qubits. Compared with separately encoding the real and imaginary parts and combining them through LCU, the construction can allow a smaller normalization and reduce amplitude-amplification costs. The computed polar representation also remains available for further arithmetic before amplitude-encoding.
summary:
1. 针对复数振幅制备，作者以实虚部二进制寄存器为输入，用CORDIC计算模与辐角，再经振幅编码和相位门近似制备归一化复振幅。
2. 可逆原位乘法器支持定精度坐标更新并清理临时空间，方案需O(n²)个T门和O(n)个额外量子比特，相较分别编码实虚部再作线性组合，可减小归一化因子并降低振幅放大开销。
3. 保留的极坐标表示可供编码前进一步运算，但摘要未量化归一化改善及其适用条件，实际资源收益仍需具体任务验证。

title: A Unified Protocol for Arbitrary Z Rotations of a Class of Bosonic cQED Qubits
abstract: Bosonic-qubit encodings provide diverse approaches to storing and processing quantum information, with logical operations often implemented through encoding-specific physical strategies. Here, we identify a class of bosonic Fock-based qubits in circuit QED for which distinct implementations of arbitrary Z rotations share a common structure. We formulate this structure as a six-step protocol that provides a unified procedure for implementing arbitrary Z rotations across this class of bosonic cQED qubits. The applicability of the protocol is determined by a specific condition on the encoding, providing a criterion for identifying bosonic Fock-based cQED qubits that admit the common implementation.
summary:
1. 针对玻色量子比特逻辑操作依赖编码的问题，作者在电路量子电动力学平台上提炼一类基于福克态编码的任意Z旋转实现结构，提出六步统一协议。
2. 该协议将不同编码的旋转实现纳入共同流程，并以编码须满足的特定条件界定适用范围，给出识别兼容量子比特的判据。
3. 这一框架可为兼容编码的逻辑门设计提供共同起点，但其适用性限于满足条件的编码，摘要未报告实验验证或门性能。

title: Qubit-environment entanglement in pure dephasing dynamics for mixed initial states
abstract: Decoherence of qubits is one main limitation in quantum information processing, where the qubits themselves can be mixed because of decoherence and additional decoherence may generated through interactions with a bath. Here, we present a complete study of qubit-environment entanglement in the case of interactions that lead to pure dephasing of the qubit by allowing the initial state of the qubit to be mixed, exceeding previous restrictions. We find that the criteria for separability that hold for pure initial states of the qubit are reduced to witness status. Yet, the evolution of the witnesses reflects the array of features that entanglement can exhibit in the mixed case but are forbidden in the pure-qubit case. Most notably, this includes sudden birth of entanglement as the initial phase of the evolution is typically separable. Moreover, there is a stark numerical advantage to the study of entanglement for large environments when using the witness rather than the traditional measures available. We include the study of entanglement generated between a spin qubit and a sparse spin environment to illustrate the peculiarities of the evolution of entanglement in this case, as well as to emphasize the level of reliability of the entanglement witness.
summary:
1. 作者研究初态为混态的量子比特在纯退相位过程中如何与环境产生纠缠，并以自旋量子比特耦合稀疏自旋环境为例检验纠缠见证。
2. 纯态情形的可分性判据在混态下仅能充当纠缠见证，但可揭示初始可分演化后的纠缠突然诞生，且相较传统纠缠度量更便于大环境数值研究。
3. 该方法为混态量子比特与复杂环境的纠缠动力学提供了计算途径，但见证不能替代完整可分性判据，其可靠性仍需结合具体模型评估。

title: The TEMPO network can be made independent of the system size
abstract: The time-evolving matrix product operator (TEMPO) method efficiently simulates non-Markovian open quantum system dynamics by contracting a two-dimensional tensor network representing the time-discretized Feynman-Vernon influence functional. The standard form of this network has an unfavorable scaling with the size of the system. We show that, within the usual second-order time-step error, the dimensions of all internal network bonds can be reduced to $(2m+1)(m+1)$, where $m$ is the number of independent coupling channels. This dimension does not depend on the number of distinct eigenvalues of the coupling operators. The system size only enters in the final boundary layer of the network, making large system sizes accessible to TEMPO methods. This structure was discovered by Claude Opus 5.5 during guided algorithm development.
summary:
1. 针对TEMPO模拟非马尔可夫开放量子动力学时网络随系统规模增长的问题，作者重构了离散费曼–弗农影响泛函的二维张量网络。
2. 在通常的二阶时间步误差内，所有内部键维数可降至(2m+1)(m+1)，仅依赖独立耦合通道数m而非耦合算符的不同本征值数，系统规模仅进入最终边界层。
3. 该结构有望扩大TEMPO可处理的系统规模，但并不消除边界层的规模依赖，摘要也未提供实际计算加速或可达规模的基准。

title: Exact decoherence dynamics of a detector coupled to vacuum fluctuations in bounded geometries
abstract: The properties of quantum vacuum are highly sensitive to the underlying spacetime geometry and boundary conditions. We investigate in this paper the decoherence dynamics of a two-level system (detector) coupled to a vacuum scalar field through the $\hat{\sigma}_z$-coupling scheme under various boundary environments. By rigorously evaluating the reduced density matrix of the detector, we derive an exact general expression for the detector's decoherence function, $\gamma(\Delta t)$, and use it to characterize the dynamical decoherence of a detector in three scenarios: free space, a perfectly reflecting boundary, and a cavity formed by two parallel reflecting boundaries. We find that in free space the detector's coherence decays monotonically with time, indicating that vacuum fluctuations alone inevitably lead to a complete loss of coherence. In the single-boundary case, by contrast, the detector's coherence displays non-monotonic time evolution: $\gamma(\Delta t)$ increases with time up to a maximum and then settles to a steady value, indicating that the initial coherence can be partially preserved due to the presence of the boundary. When the detector is placed inside a cavity, its coherence evolution exhibits oscillatory behavior, and a significant fraction of the initial coherence survives. Moreover, for the same detector-boundary distance, more coherence is preserved in the cavity case than in the single-boundary case. These results provide a viable route for engineering quantum coherence via boundary conditions.
summary:
1. 针对边界如何改变真空诱导退相干，作者严格求解以σ_z耦合标量真空场的二能级探测器约化密度矩阵，获得退相干函数的精确通式。
2. 自由空间中相干性单调衰减至零，单反射边界使退相干函数先增后趋稳并保留部分相干，双平行反射壁腔内则出现振荡，且同等探测器—边界距离下保留更多相干。
3. 结果表明边界条件可在该理想模型中抑制真空诱导退相干，为相干调控提供理论路径，但实际边界与实验实现仍待检验。

title: Quantum Fisher Information Deficit as a Geometric Signature of Strong-to-Weak Spontaneous Symmetry Breaking
abstract: Recently, strong-to-weak spontaneous symmetry breaking (SW-SSB) has been established as a framework for describing quantum phases in open systems. However SW-SSB cannot be characterized by conventional charged two-point correlators. In this work, we show that, for strongly $\mathbb{Z}_2$-symmetric states with local charged involutions, SW-SSB manifests as a persistent deficit from the maximal quantum Fisher information (QFI) under symmetry-neutral pair rotations. A model-independent inequality hierarchy establishes the equivalence of this deficit with fidelity and Rényi-1 correlators as asymptotic long-range-order diagnostics. It thereby connects finite-angle state overlaps to a constraint on the infinitesimal Bures geometry along the same pair-generated orbit. For symmetry-projected Gibbs states, we further derive a lower bound on the deficit governed by the mean energy injected by the pair operation. Crucially, locality keeps this energy cost uniformly bounded in system size and endpoint separation, maintaining a finite gap below the maximal QFI at any fixed finite temperature. When ordinary charged long range order is absent, this persistent geometric constraint provides a quantitative information-geometric characterization of thermal SW-SSB.
summary:
1. 针对开放系统中传统带荷两点关联难以刻画的强到弱自发对称性破缺，作者在具有局域带荷对合算符的强Z₂对称态中，研究中性成对旋转下的量子费舍尔信息亏损。
2. 模型无关的不等式层级证明，持续亏损与保真度及Rényi-1长程序诊断等价；对称投影吉布斯态中，局域性能量代价界保证任意固定有限温度下亏损非零。
3. 在普通带荷长程序缺失时，该结果为热态强到弱对称性破缺提供定量几何表征，但推广至其他对称性仍待研究。

title: Quantum circuits of elastic wave equations via Schrödingerisation
abstract: We construct explicit quantum circuits for the velocity-stress formulation of elastic wave equations in homogeneous media using Schrödingerisation. After rewriting the equations in symmetric matrix form(SMF), we use Fourier spectral discretization for source-driven periodic problems and staggered-grid finite differences for Dirichlet, Neumann, and impedance boundary conditions. The Schrödingerisation method transforms any linear PDEs into a system of Schrödinger-type PDEs -with unitary evolution- using the warped phase transformation that maps the equations in one higher dimension. For periodic problems, we develop circuits by combining controlled Fourier-mode rotations. For physical boundaries, interleaved encoding swaps the spatial and field-component registers, enabling a more efficient circuit construction using shift operators. We analyze $p$th-order Trotter-Suzuki formulas and derive splitting-error and CNOT-gate estimates, under the assumptions of smooth auxiliary initialization and solution-state recovery. Comparison with classical partitioned splitting methods identifies a polynomial improvement in spatial-resolution dependence for the quantum state-evolution subroutine. Noiseless circuit simulations of a forced periodic problem and an impedance problem illustrate the constructions and quantify their errors against exact solutions and classical reference computations.
summary:
1. 针对均匀介质弹性波的量子模拟，作者将速度—应力方程对称化并经薛定谔化升维为幺正演化，结合傅里叶谱法或交错网格差分构造周期及物理边界量子线路。
2. 受控模态旋转与交错编码支撑线路实现，分裂误差和CNOT门数估计表明，量子态演化子程序在空间分辨率依赖上较经典分裂法具多项式改进，无噪声算例量化了误差。
3. 该方案为弹性波量子模拟提供线路基础，但优势依赖光滑辅助初始化和解态恢复假设，无噪声演示尚不代表端到端或含噪计算优势。

title: HTM: A Hybrid Classical-Quantum Computation Model
abstract: Classical and quantum computers have achieved collaborative computation and completed applications across numerous fields. Nevertheless, the absence of a unified hybrid computation model has led to issues such as non-standardized engineering architecture design, ambiguous task partitioning criteria and so on. To address these issues, this research proposes a hybrid classical-quantum computation model (HTM). By constructing unified state sets and transition function representations, HTM clarifies hybrid control logic and implements a control-sharing mechanism. Simultaneously, a comprehensive complexity calculation method based on entanglement and superposition was proposed, supporting computation task partitioning and resource scheduling. The HTM fills a theoretical gap in the classical-quantum hybrid computation area and implements the joint promotion and development of computing models and hardware.
summary:
1. 针对经典与量子协同计算中控制逻辑和任务划分缺乏统一描述的问题，作者提出混合计算模型HTM，以统一状态集和转移函数表述两类计算。
2. 该模型引入控制共享机制，并提出基于纠缠与叠加的综合复杂度计算方法，为任务划分和资源调度提供形式化依据，但摘要未给出性能验证。
3. 这一框架可为混合架构设计提供统一语言，其复杂度度量能否有效指导实际硬件上的任务分配与资源优化，仍需具体实现和基准测试检验。

title: Homodyne Unravelling and Parameter Estimation in Squeezed Thermal Baths
abstract: We derive an alternative formulation of the stochastic master equation describing the evolution of quantum systems continuously measured via homodyne detection in a squeezed-thermal environment. This formulation allows us to identify two distinct collapse operators, corresponding respectively to the monitored and unmonitored channels, and to express the quantum state evolution directly in terms of Kraus-like operators. As a consequence, it facilitates the application of advanced numerical methods that account for higher-order corrections and discrete-time monitoring, and it also enables the efficient numerical evaluation of Cramér-Rao bounds in parameter estimation problems. To demonstrate the latter, we evaluate the Fisher information of the continuous homodyne monitoring for qubit frequency estimation in the presence of a squeezed-thermal bath. Our results show that exponential scaling of the steady-state Fisher information rate with squeezing is retained even at non-zero temperature.
summary:
1. 针对压缩热浴中零差连续测量的条件动力学，作者重构随机主方程，分离受监测与未监测通道的坍缩算符，并以类克劳斯算符表述量子态演化。
2. 该表述便于数值求取参数估计的克拉美–罗界，量子比特频率估计的计算显示，稳态费舍尔信息率随压缩程度的指数标度在非零温度下仍保留。
3. 这一框架可支持含高阶修正和离散时间监测的数值方法，但所示指数标度限于所研究的频率估计模型，尚不能直接推及其他参数或系统。

title: Recovering classical gauge geometry from quantum master constraints
abstract: Exact normalizable solutions of quantum constraints form a symplectic submanifold of the space of rays, whereas classical first-class constraints define a surface on which the symplectic form is degenerate. We ask how the degenerate directions can be recovered when quantum theory is regarded as fundamental and the constraints are imposed through a single positive master operator. For a nonnegative master function whose zero set is a Morse--Bott critical manifold, the image of the linearized Hamiltonian vector field is the symplectic orthogonal of the zero set, and coisotropy is equivalent to this linearization having square zero. The image is fixed by the zero set, but the theorem identifies it with the response of the master dynamics, which makes it accessible to quantum states. Three realizations follow. The exact quantum physical space is the opposite, rotational case of the same dichotomy. For quadratic masters, the bottom of the spectrum is $(\hbar/2)\Tr_+L$, so first-class zero sets carry no offset of order $\hbar$; within the harmonic approximation this explains the $\hbar$ versus $\hbar^2$ offsets observed in tests of the master-constraint programme. Finally, the second time derivative of the limiting covariance of a semiclassical packet, which can be determined by bounded probes, has the gauge distribution as its image. Two oscillators at fixed total energy give exact master evolution, an exact realization of this covariance shear, and the reduced symplectic limit. For the non-Abelian SL(2,$\R$) model we compute the coherent and Weyl master symbols, prove essential self-adjointness and a finite-time propagation estimate, and derive the spectral bottom $\hbar^2/2$.
summary:
1. 针对精确量子约束态空间如何恢复经典规范退化方向的问题，作者以正主约束算符、莫尔斯–博特零集及半经典波包协方差建立几何联系。
2. 证明规范方向对应主动力学线性化的像，共各向同性等价于其平方为零，并由极限协方差的二阶时间导数提取该方向，在双振子中精确实现，另得非阿贝尔模型谱底ℏ²/2。
3. 结果提供了用有界探针读取经典规范分布的途径，但一般恢复依赖所述几何与半经典条件，ℏ与ℏ²谱偏移的解释限于谐近似。

title: Meet-in-the-Middle Compilation of the $[\mathrm{CNOT}]$ Class with Fibonacci Anyons
abstract: Compilation of two-qubit Fibonacci anyon gates is complicated by leakage ($\ell$) from the four-dimensional computational sector to the fifth state of the fusion space. We construct a GPU pipeline to find low-leakage representatives of the $[\text{CNOT}]$ class on different subsets of the braid group. We exhaustively explore the full positive five-generator alphabet up to $L=21$ with minimal leakage $\ell\sim10^{-3}$ and error $d_{[\text{CNOT}]}\sim 10^{-8}$ on it. To reach larger lengths, the search space is successively narrowed to three-generator, boundary-$\sigma_3$, and palindromic braids, and by considering only the Garside left normal form. These optimizations allow us to reach $L=72$. For $L=69$, a braid with $\ell\sim10^{-10}$ and $d_{[\text{CNOT}]}\sim 10^{-10}$ is found. In addition to directly enumerating optimal braids, we proved that $\ell\in\mathbb Z[\varphi]$, and any nonzero leakage obeys an exponential lower bound in the braid length, and obtained the limit laws $F_{3,\infty}(\ell)=\ell^2$ and $F_{5,\infty}(\ell)=\ell^4$ for our sets. Using asymptotics for the distribution function $F$, we showed that for sufficiently long braids, the asymptotics of exhaustive search are better than the asymptotics of random sampling for finding low-leakage braids.
summary:
1. 针对斐波那契任意子双量子比特门向非计算态泄漏的问题，作者构建GPU编译搜索流程，穷举短辫并逐步限制长辫搜索空间。
2. 在长度69找到泄漏与CNOT等价类误差均约为10⁻¹⁰的辫，并证明非零泄漏随辫长的指数下界，结合数值构造与解析约束刻画编译性能。
3. 分布渐近分析表明，足够长辫的低泄漏搜索中穷举优于随机采样，但长辫数值结果来自受限集合，尚不能确立全辫群的最优编译性能。

title: Classical Verification of Quantum Computation Beyond the Polynomial Hierarchy
abstract: It is not known whether a classical polynomial-time verifier can verify arbitrary polynomial-time quantum computations with an efficient quantum honest prover without computational assumptions. We show that, relative to a classical oracle, such verification is possible for a language beyond the polynomial hierarchy that is decided exactly in quantum polynomial time. The protocol is public-coin, with perfect completeness and soundness error at most 1/4. To our knowledge, no language with such a proof system was previously proved to lie outside AM relative to an oracle. For every unbounded polynomial-time computable function, the oracle can be chosen so that the message count and the oracle query counts of the quantum algorithm, verifier, and honest prover are bounded by this function of the input length. The message count is optimal up to a constant factor, since for a suitable oracle every interactive proof system for the language uses at least a constant fraction of the messages of our protocol on infinitely many lengths, with a constant depending on its verifier. The language is a variant of recursive Fourier sampling in which code tables encode secrets that address data tables. The tables are evaluated recursively, and the oracle stores only the leaves. The quantum algorithm recovers every secret exactly, and the verifier checks the prover's secrets recursively against random code entries. The recursion restricts the input in a correlated way, as the same secret fixes the code bits and chooses the free coordinate, so Håstad's switching lemma does not apply. We prove a switching theorem for these restrictions, which may be of independent interest. For instances of sufficient height, no constant-depth circuit of size $2^{\mathrm{poly}(n)}$ changes its output with probability above $2^{-\Omega(n)}$ when the answer of a random instance is flipped by changing a single leaf.
summary:
1. 针对经典验证量子计算的问题，作者在经典预言机模型中构造递归傅里叶采样变体，并以递归抽查秘密实现经典多项式时间交互验证。
2. 该语言可由量子多项式时间精确判定且超出多项式层级，公开随机协议具有完美完备性、至多四分之一的可靠性误差，消息数在常数因子内最优。
3. 结果展示了预言机模型中经典验证的能力边界，新的切换定理或可用于相关复杂性下界，但尚未解决无计算假设下任意高效量子计算的经典验证问题。

title: Optimal quantum discrimination at Liouvillian exceptional points
abstract: Central to non-Hermitian sensing is the question of whether exceptional points (EPs) can make weak perturbations easier to detect. We show that despite enhanced spectral response, in finite-dimensional Lindblad systems with a unique stationary state and a nonzero relaxation gap, EPs offer no fundamental advantage in how the observation time required for reliable detection of a weak perturbation scales with the perturbation strength. We nevertheless demonstrate that by selectively choosing perturbations that enhance the quantum Fisher information rate, EPs can shorten the observation time needed to reach a predefined detection accuracy relative to a comparable non-EP reference at the same decay rate. As an illustration, we show using an optomechanical model at an EP that we can detect a weak force through the cavity output at the same reliability in less time than a non-EP reference. Our results establish fundamental limits on perturbation detection at EPs and can guide the design of faster non-Hermitian sensors based on optomechanical resonators, superconducting qubits, and trapped ions.
summary:
1. 针对例外点能否加速弱扰动检测，作者分析具有唯一稳态和非零弛豫隙的有限维林德布拉德系统，并以光力学模型检验。
2. 例外点不改善可靠检测所需时间随扰动强度的标度，但选择提高量子费舍尔信息率的扰动，可较同衰减率的非例外点参照更快达到既定精度。
3. 光力学模型展示了经腔输出更快检测弱力的可能，并为传感器设计提供方向，但该优势依赖扰动选择，不等同于普适标度增益。

title: Exact Analytical Treatment of Collectively Pumped Dicke Superradiance
abstract: We study the dynamics of an ensemble of $N$ two-level emitters undergoing collective decay at rate $\Gamma$ and collective incoherent pumping at rate $R$, confined to the fully symmetric Dicke ladder. Although the population dynamics are confined to a finite set of rate equations, their quantum-trajectory representation involves infinitely many pump-decay histories. We derive an exact finite continued fraction for the Laplace-transformed Dicke-state populations by resumming the infinitely many quantum trajectories generated by competing pump and decay processes. Our construction provides a physically transparent interpretation of the tridiagonal resolvent and extends to arbitrary permutationally symmetric initial states. In the strong- and weak-pumping regimes, we obtain perturbative transient solutions. We also identify exact relaxation eigenvalues and emission observables at balanced pump and decay strengths. Our solution provides a starting point for extending trajectory-based analytical methods to more general driven-dissipative collective systems.
summary:
1. 针对全对称迪克阶梯中两能级发射体的集体泵浦与衰减动力学，作者重求和无限量子轨迹，将态布居的拉普拉斯变换化为精确有限连分式。
2. 该方法适用于任意置换对称初态，给出强弱泵浦下的微扰瞬态解，并在泵浦与衰减等强时得到精确弛豫本征值及发射观测量。
3. 结果为轨迹解析法推广至更一般的驱动耗散集体系统提供起点，但当前精确构造仍限于全对称迪克阶梯。
